body_en: Brussels Airport to expand border controls as EES delays persist, government registration kiosks remain offline - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Brussels Airport (BRU) Brussels Airport to expand border controls as EES delays persist, government registration...

Brussels Airport will add eight manual border-control positions for arriving passengers by the end of 2026 and install six additional electronic gates in early 2027, as long waiting times linked to the European Entry/Exit System (EES) continue to disrupt passenger flows. The latest investment comes despite an earlier expansion of border-control infrastructure, with the airport saying that processing times under the new system remain significantly longer than anticipated. Brussels Airport is also pointing to unresolved technical problems affecting government-supplied registration equipment and calling for further action by European authorities.

The EES introduces digital registration of non-EU nationals travelling into and out of the Schengen Area, including the collection of facial images and fingerprints. According to Brussels Airport, the additional procedures have substantially increased the time required to process arriving passengers. During morning peak periods, the average processing time for each arriving visa passenger is now two to three times longer than before the system’s introduction. The airport says this has resulted in long queues at border control, with waiting times of two to four hours regularly reported at airports across Europe. After a slight improvement in August, waiting times at Brussels Airport increased again in September as biometric registration activity rose.

The airport had already increased the number of manual border-control positions by 20 per cent at arrivals and 25 per cent at departures during 2025, ahead of the EES rollout. These increases exceeded passenger traffic growth, but have proved insufficient to offset the longer processing times. The eight additional positions planned for December will increase arrival border-control capacity by 66 per cent, according to the airport. This means manual capacity at arrivals will have doubled within 12 months. The airport says the new positions must still be brought into operation in consultation with the authorities and other partners involved.

A further six electronic gates, ordered from the Federal Police in May 2026 and scheduled for delivery in early 2027, are expected to increase e-gate capacity at arrivals by 50 per cent. However, access to automated border checks remains restricted for some non-European travellers. Certain nationalities that could previously use e-gates are no longer eligible to do so under the new procedures, while other passengers must first complete EES registration.
Government registration technology still not operational

One of the more significant problems highlighted by Brussels Airport concerns 60 pre-registration kiosks purchased last year to help travellers complete EES registration before reaching a manual border-control desk. The kiosks were intended to reduce the workload at staffed counters and allow eligible non-EU nationals to use electronic gates.

Although the competent authorities decided before the summer that travellers from certain non-European countries could use the system, Brussels Airport says technical problems involving government suppliers mean the kiosks are still not operational. The airport expects the technology to help reduce queues, particularly for departing passengers, once it becomes available. On arrival, however, access to e-gates remains limited to certain nationalities and travellers already registered in the EES.

Brussels Airport is also calling for improvements to the implementation of the EES at European level, backing demands from Airports Council International Europe (ACI Europe) and Airlines for Europe. Proposed measures include optimising biometric checks and introducing a widely available application through which travellers could register in advance. Brussels Airport says only Sweden and Portugal currently offer such an application, and that a suitable solution should also be available in Belgium.

The airport further argues that authorities should retain sufficient flexibility to respond when queues become excessive. One measure it supports is the temporary suspension of biometric registration during periods of severe congestion, while maintaining the necessary security checks.

The expansion plans underline the operational challenge facing Brussels Airport as the EES becomes part of routine border processing. While additional counters and electronic gates should increase capacity, the airport’s own assessment indicates that infrastructure alone will not resolve the problem. The timely introduction of the delayed registration technology, wider access to automated checks and changes to the system’s implementation will also be necessary if waiting times are to return to acceptable levels.

Brussels Airport says it is working with the relevant authorities and government departments through a dedicated steering group, with the stated objective of maintaining secure and accurate border checks while reducing delays for passengers.

body_zh: 由于EES持续延误，布鲁塞尔机场扩大边境管制，政府登记亭仍处于离线状态 - Aviation24.be
首页 机场 布鲁塞尔机场 (BRU) 布鲁塞尔机场将扩大边境管制，因为 EES 持续延误、政府登记...
布鲁塞尔机场将在 2026 年底前为抵达旅客增加 8 个手动边境管制站，并在 2027 年初安装 6 个额外的电子登机口，因为与欧洲出入境系统 (EES) 相关的漫长等待时间继续扰乱客流。尽管早些时候扩大了边境管制基础设施，但最新的投资还是出现了，机场表示新系统下的处理时间仍然比预期长得多。布鲁塞尔机场还指出，尚未解决的技术问题影响了政府提供的登记设备，并呼吁欧洲当局采取进一步行动。
EES 引入了对进出申根区的非欧盟国民进行数字登记，包括收集面部图像和指纹。据布鲁塞尔机场称，额外的程序大大增加了处理抵达乘客所需的时间。在早高峰期间，每位入境签证旅客的平均处理时间比该系统推出前长了两到三倍。机场表示，这导致边境管制处排起长队，欧洲各地机场的等待时间经常长达两到四个小时。继 8 月份略有改善后，随着生物识别登记活动的增加，布鲁塞尔机场的等待时间在 9 月份再次增加。
在 EES 推出之前，机场已于 2025 年将抵达时的手动边境管制位置数量增加了 20%，出发时的手动边境管制位置数量增加了 25%。这些增长超过了客运量的增长，但事实证明不足以抵消更长的处理时间。据机场称，计划于 12 月增设 8 个职位，将使入境边境管制能力增加 66%。这意味着到达站的人工运力将在 12 个月内增加一倍。机场表示，新职位的投入运营仍须与当局和其他相关合作伙伴协商。
联邦警察于 2026 年 5 月订购了另外 6 个电子登机口，计划于 2027 年初交付，预计将使电子登机口的入境容量增加 50%。然而，对于一些非欧洲旅客来说，进行自动边境检查仍然受到限制。根据新程序，以前可以使用电子登机口的某些国籍的乘客不再有资格使用，而其他乘客必须首先完成 EES 注册。
政府登记技术仍未投入使用
布鲁塞尔机场强调的更重要的问题之一涉及去年购买的 60 个预登记亭，以帮助旅客在到达手动边境管制柜台之前完成 EES 登记。这些信息亭的目的是减少柜台的工作量，并允许符合条件的非欧盟国民使用电子门。
尽管主管部门在今年夏天之前决定允许来自某些非欧洲国家的旅客使用该系统，但布鲁塞尔机场表示，涉及政府供应商的技术问题意味着这些自助值机亭仍无法运行。机场预计，一旦这项技术投入使用，将有助于减少排队现象，特别是对于离境旅客而言。然而，抵达后，电子登机口的使用仍然仅限于某些国籍和已在 EES 中注册的旅客。
布鲁塞尔机场还呼吁在欧洲层面改进 EES 的实施，支持欧洲国际机场理事会 (ACI Europe) 和欧洲航空公司的要求。拟议的措施包括优化生物识别检查并引入广泛使用的应用程序，旅客可以通过该应用程序提前登记。布鲁塞尔机场表示，目前只有瑞典和葡萄牙提供此类应用程序，比利时也应该有合适的解决方案。
机场进一步辩称，当局应保留足够的灵活性，以便在排队人数过多时做出反应。它支持的一项措施是在严重拥堵期间暂时停止生物识别注册，同时保持必要的安全检查。
随着 EES 成为常规边境处理的一部分，扩建计划凸显了布鲁塞尔机场面临的运营挑战。虽然额外的柜台和电子门应该会增加容量，但机场自己的评估表明，仅靠基础设施并不能解决问题。如果等待时间要恢复到可接受的水平，还需要及时引入延迟注册技术、更广泛地使用自动检查以及对系统实施进行更改。
布鲁塞尔机场表示，它正在通过一个专门的指导小组与有关当局和政府部门合作，其既定目标是维持安全和准确的边境检查，同时减少乘客的延误。

title_en: Allegiant orders six more Boeing 737 MAX jets for 2028 delivery
title_zh: Allegiant 又订购了六架波音 737 MAX 喷气式飞机，将于 2028 年交付
summary: Allegiant Air has ordered six additional Boeing 737 MAX aircraft for delivery in 2028, exercising its first purchase… The post Allegiant orders six more Boeing 737 MAX jets for 2028 delivery appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 忠诚航空已额外订购六架波音 737 MAX 飞机，将于 2028 年交付，这是其首次采购……忠诚航空订购了六架波音 737 MAX 飞机。
body_en: Allegiant Air has ordered six additional Boeing 737 MAX aircraft for delivery in 2028, exercising its first purchase options under an agreement signed with Boeing in 2021.

The Las Vegas-based airline disclosed the purchase on October 23, 2026. The six 737-8s bring its firm purchases under the agreement to 56 aircraft, of which 22 had been delivered as of October 23. Allegiant retains options for another 74 jets.
Allegiant listed the six aircraft’s combined list price at more than $720 million before discounts and price adjustments through delivery. It did not disclose the negotiated purchase price.

The order extends Allegiant’s investment in new Boeing aircraft after years of building its low-cost operation largely around used jets. When it announced the original 50-aircraft purchase in January 2022, Allegiant operated 108 Airbus A319s and A320s.

The original deal included the smaller 737-7 and higher-capacity 737-8-200, with options for 50 more aircraft. Allegiant said the new jets would allow it to replace retiring aircraft and expand its fleet while lowering fuel consumption.
Allegiant originally expected to receive its first MAX in 2023 and all 50 firm aircraft by the end of 2025, but deliveries were delayed. Its first 737-8-200 arrived in September 2024.

In November 2024, the airline amended its agreement with Boeing to reduce the number of aircraft arriving in 2024 and 2025 and extend deliveries of the original order through the end of 2027. Allegiant said that agreement also included benefits and other considerations related to the delays.

The first Allegiant MAX entered passenger service in October 2024. In an investor presentation that month, Allegiant said delivery delays were costing it approximately $30 million annually and that it was working with Boeing to seek compensation.

At the time of the original announcement, Allegiant said the MAX aircraft would burn approximately 20% less fuel than its older Airbus A320-family jets while offering more seats. The airline also signed a 12-year maintenance agreement with CFM International covering the new aircraft’s LEAP-1B engines.
The latest purchase leaves 34 firm aircraft still to be delivered under the Boeing agreement.

body_zh: 忠实航空已额外订购了六架波音 737 MAX 飞机，将于 2028 年交付，根据 2021 年与波音公司签署的协议行使首次购买选择权。
这家总部位于拉斯维加斯的航空公司于 2026 年 10 月 23 日披露了此次采购事宜。这家 6 架 737-8 飞机将根据协议确定采购 56 架飞机，其中 22 架已于 10 月 23 日交付。Allegiant 保留另外 74 架喷气式飞机的选择权。
Allegiant 列出的六架飞机在折扣和交付价格调整前的总标价超过 7.2 亿美元。它没有透露协商的购买价格。
在多年来主要围绕二手飞机建立低成本运营之后，该订单扩大了忠诚公司对新型波音飞机的投资。当忠实于 2022 年 1 月宣布最初购买 50 架飞机时，运营着 108 架空客 A319 和 A320。
最初的交易包括较小的 737-7 和容量较大的 737-8-200，以及另外 50 架飞机的选择。 Allegiant 表示，新飞机将使其能够替换退役的飞机并扩大机队，同时降低燃油消耗。
Allegiant 最初预计于 2023 年接收第一架 MAX，并于 2025 年底接收全部 50 架飞机，但交付被推迟。首架 737-8-200 于 2024 年 9 月抵达。
2024 年 11 月，该航空公司修改了与波音公司的协议，减少了 2024 年和 2025 年抵达的飞机数量，并将原始订单的交付期限延长至 2027 年底。Allegiant 表示，该协议还包括与延误相关的好处和其他考虑因素。
第一架 Allegiant MAX 于 2024 年 10 月投入客运服务。在当月的投资者介绍中，Allegiant 表示，交付延误每年给该公司造成约 3000 万美元的损失，该公司正在与波音公司合作寻求赔偿。
在最初发布公告时，Allegiant 表示 MAX 飞机将比其旧款空客 A320 系列飞机燃烧约 20% 的燃油，同时提供更多座位。该航空公司还与 CFM International 签署了一份为期 12 年的维护协议，涵盖新飞机的 LEAP-1B 发动机。
根据波音协议，最新购买的飞机仍有 34 架飞机有待交付。
Allegiant 又订购了 6 架波音 737 MAX 喷气式飞机，将于 2028 年交付，这一消息首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

title_en: Delta One's 'Biggest Overhaul In 30 Years' Still Has A Smaller Screen Than United's Polaris Studio
title_zh: 达美航空“30年来最大的一次改造”的屏幕仍然比美联航北极星工作室小
summary: Delta One's rebrand covers every aspect of the in-flight experience, from culinary additions to aesthetics.
summary_zh: 达美航空的品牌重塑涵盖了飞行体验的各个方面，从烹饪添加到美学。
body_en: Delta One's 'Biggest Overhaul In 30 Years' Still Has A Smaller Screen Than United's Polaris Studio

Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

Delta Air Lines is presenting its latest Delta One redesign as its most comprehensive premium-cabin overhaul in nearly 30 years, but one headline feature leaves room for a rival to claim an advantage. Delta’s next-generation suite on the Airbus A350-1000 will have a 24-inch (60.96 cm) 4K QLED seatback display, the largest in the airline's history. Delta's rival, United Airlines , now offers Polaris Studio suites, introduced on its redesigned Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner , featuring a 27-inch (68.58 cm) 4K OLED display. United’s screen is three inches larger diagonally.

Announced on October 14, Delta’s redesign focuses on dining, hospitality, and rest, including a longer meal preselection window, a sleep-first breakfast option, refreshed amenities, and new beverage partnerships. Service changes will begin on select flights departing Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) this fall before expanding across the global network. Delta is also preparing a new suite for A350-1000 aircraft and retrofits for Airbus A330-200 and Airbus A330-300 jets. The rollout combines immediate service changes with a longer hardware transition.
A Broad Service Redesign, Not Just A New Suite

Delta calls the project its largest and most holistic Delta One redesign in nearly three decades, building on more than $1 billion invested in its fleet. The goal is a more consistent journey from airport to aircraft. The culinary program was developed with chef Simon Hulstone and Master Sommelier Andrea Robinson. It emphasizes familiar dishes with upgraded ingredients, including a Wagyu beef burger and regionally inspired sea bass, alongside refreshed desserts and tableware. Delta says the program reflects customer feedback and aims to improve consistency as well as presentation. The airline produces around eight million Delta One meals annually through international kitchens, making execution across routes a significant operational undertaking.

Hospitality changes include a “sip and settle” moment with a preferred beverage, warm nuts, and a hot towel before the meal. Fresh-cracked pepper and sauces served separately give passengers more control over how dishes are finished. Their success depends on consistent delivery by crews and catering teams. The program will first appear on transoceanic Delta One routes departing LAX in fall 2026, with broader expansion planned for early 2027. This is a staged rollout, not a single fleetwide launch. Travelers booking during the transition should check the aircraft and service details for their flight rather than assume every advertised element is already available.
The 24-Inch Display Is A Major Upgrade, But Not The Biggest

Delta’s upcoming A350-1000 suite will feature a 24-inch 4K QLED screen, Bluetooth headphone connectivity, wireless charging, and additional storage. The suite is also designed around a longer lie-flat bed and privacy doors. These changes should improve entertainment and usability on long-haul journeys. United’s Polaris Studio moves the screen benchmark to 27 inches, with a 4K OLED panel. The suites debuted on United’s elevated interior Boeing 787-9 with privacy doors, wireless charging, Bluetooth connectivity, upgraded bedding, and a companion ottoman in six of the eight Studio suites. United describes the display as the largest among US airlines. United’s screen is three inches larger diagonally, although QLED and OLED differ, and size alone does not determine viewing quality. OLED panels can produce individually lit pixels and deep blacks, while QLED displays use a quantum-dot layer with LED backlighting; actual performance also depends on implementation.

The comparison applies to specific next-generation products, not every seat on either airline. Polaris Studio is a premium subset of United’s Polaris cabin, while Delta’s new suite is tied to incoming A350-1000s and planned A330 refurbishments. Existing aircraft can have different seats and entertainment hardware. Viewing angle, glare, responsiveness, content, and comfort also affect the experience. United wins the numerical comparison; Delta’s overall proposition depends on the complete suite and the consistency of its delivery.
Meal Preselection And Sleep-First Service Target Practical Needs

Delta is extending entrée preselection to 18 hours before departure, six hours closer to departure than its previous window. It says this is the latest pre-order cutoff offered by any US carrier. The later cutoff may help travelers with changing plans and improve catering forecasts. The sleep-first option lets passengers skip a full pre-arrival breakfast and receive coffee and a croissant instead. On overnight flights, a conventional meal can interrupt rest even when the food is well-prepared. A lighter alternative recognizes that not every passenger values the same number of courses, particularly before landing.

Emirates also offers advance meal selection . Eligible Business Class passengers can pre-order main courses as early as 14 days before departure and up to 24 hours before the flight, although the option is limited to selected routes. Its longer window lets passengers secure a preferred dish earlier, while Delta’s new selling point is its later cutoff. These systems are not identical, and route eligibility matters.
Premium Drinks And Amenities Add Distinction, But Execution Matters

Delta is refreshing its beverage lineup with a wine program curated by Andrea Robinson. The airline says it has selected 13 wines from 11 wineries for the October 2026 to September 2027 period, moving from four annual rotations to two. Fewer rotations may help crews deliver more consistent service while retaining variety. The lineup also introduces Dassai 45 sake on selected routes to and from Tokyo-Haneda (HND), plus cocktails and mocktails including Hugo Spritz and Paloma variations. Blanton’s Single Barrel Bourbon is scheduled to join the offering on December 1, 2026. Delta says it will be the first and only airline to serve the label, using the partnership to give the cabin a recognizable premium identity. Availability can still depend on route, provisioning, and rollout timing.
body_zh: 达美航空“30年来最大的一次改造”的屏幕仍然比美联航北极星工作室小
杰克 (Jack) 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了简单飞行 (Simple Flying)。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。

达美航空正在展示其最新的达美一号重新设计，这是其近 30 年来最全面的高级客舱改造，但其中一个头条新闻为竞争对手留下了占据优势的空间。达美航空在空客 A350-1000 上的下一代套房将配备 24 英寸（60.96 厘米）4K QLED 椅背显示屏，这是该航空公司历史上最大的。达美航空的竞争对手联合航空现在提供 Polaris Studio 套件，该套件在其重新设计的波音 787-9 梦想飞机上推出，配备 27 英寸（68.58 厘米）4K OLED 显示屏。曼联的屏幕对角线大了三英寸。

达美航空于 10 月 14 日宣布，重新设计的重点是餐饮、招待和休息，包括更长的膳食预选窗口、睡眠优先的早餐选项、更新的设施以及新的饮料合作伙伴关系。服务变更将于今年秋季从洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 出发的部分航班开始，然后扩展到全球网络。达美航空还正在为 A350-1000 飞机准备一套新套件，并为空客 A330-200 和空客 A330-300 喷气式飞机进行改装。此次推出将即时服务变更与较长的硬件过渡结合起来。
广泛的服务重新设计，而不仅仅是新套件

达美航空将该项目称为近三十年来最大、最全面的达美一号重新设计项目，其机队投资超过 10 亿美元。目标是从机场到飞机的旅程更加一致。烹饪项目由主厨 Simon Hulstone 和侍酒师 Andrea Robinson 共同制定。它强调采用升级食材的熟悉菜肴，包括和牛牛肉汉堡和当地风味的鲈鱼，以及新鲜的甜点和餐具。达美航空表示，该计划反映了客户的反馈，旨在提高一致性和展示效果。该航空公司每年通过国际厨房生产约 800 万份达美航空餐食，这使得跨航线的执行成为一项重要的运营任务。

招待方式的变化包括在餐前“小酌一杯，安顿下来”，享用首选饮料、热坚果和热毛巾。新鲜胡椒和酱汁分开供应，让乘客可以更好地控制菜肴的制作方式。他们的成功取决于工作人员和餐饮团队的持续交付。该计划将于 2026 年秋季首次出现在从洛杉矶国际机场出发的跨洋达美航空航线上，并计划于 2027 年初进行更广泛的扩展。这是分阶段推出，而不是在整个机队范围内单独推出。在过渡期间预订的旅客应检查其航班的飞机和服务详细信息，而不是假设所有广告元素都已可用。
24 英寸显示屏是一次重大升级，但不是最大的升级

达美航空即将推出的 A350-1000 套件将配备 24 英寸 4K QLED 屏幕、蓝牙耳机连接、无线充电和额外存储空间。套房还围绕更长的平躺床和隐私门进行设计。这些变化应该会改善长途旅行的娱乐性和可用性。 United 的 Polaris Studio 将屏幕基准提升至 27 英寸，配备 4K OLED 面板。这些套房在美联航的高架内饰波音 787-9 上首次亮相，配有隐私门、无线充电、蓝牙连接、升级的床上用品，八间单间套房中的六间还配有配套脚凳。美联航称该显示屏是美国航空公司中最大的。尽管 QLED 和 OLED 有所不同，United 的屏幕对角线大了 3 英寸，而且尺寸本身并不能决定观看质量。 OLED 面板可以产生单独发光的像素和深黑色，而 QLED 显示器则使用带有 LED 背光的量子点层；实际效果还取决于实施。
该比较适用于特定的下一代产品，而不是两家航空公司的每个座位。 Polaris Studio 是美联航 Polaris 客舱的高级子集，而达美航空的新套房则与即将上市的 A350-1000 和计划中的 A330 翻新飞机相关。现有的飞机可以有不同的座位和娱乐硬件。视角、眩光、响应能力、内容和舒适度也会影响体验。曼联在数值对比中获胜；达美航空的整体主张取决于完整的套件及其交付的一致性。
餐食预选、睡眠优先服务瞄准实际需求
达美航空将主菜预选时间延长至起飞前 18 小时，比之前的窗口时间提前了 6 小时。该公司表示，这是美国航空公司提供的最新预订截止日期。较晚的截止时间可能有助于旅客改变计划并改善餐饮预测。 “睡眠优先”选项让乘客无需享用全套抵达前早餐，而是享用咖啡和羊角面包。在夜间航班上，即使食物准备充分，传统膳食也可能会中断休息。一个更轻松的替代方案认识到并非每个乘客都重视相同数量的课程，特别是在着陆之前。
阿联酋航空还提供提前膳食选择。符合条件的商务舱乘客最早可以在出发前 14 天和航班起飞前 24 小时预订主菜，但该选项仅限于选定的航线。其较长的窗口让乘客可以更早地获得喜欢的菜肴，而达美航空的新卖点是其较晚的截止时间。这些系统并不相同，路线资格也很重要。
优质饮品和便利设施增添特色，但执行力很重要

达美航空正在通过由 Andrea Robinson 策划的葡萄酒节目来更新其饮料阵容。该航空公司表示，已从 11 个酒庄挑选了 13 款葡萄酒供 2026 年 10 月至 2027 年 9 月期间使用，从每年 4 次轮换变为每年 2 次。更少的轮换可以帮助工作人员提供更一致的服务，同时保持多样性。该阵容还在往返东京羽田机场 (HND) 的特定航线上推出了 Dassai 45 清酒，以及包括 Hugo Spritz 和 Paloma 在内的鸡尾酒和无酒精鸡尾酒。布兰顿 (Blanton) 的单桶波本威士忌 (Single Barrel Bourbon) 计划于 2026 年 12 月 1 日加入该活动。达美航空表示，它将成为第一家也是唯一一家提供该品牌服务的航空公司，利用此次合作为客舱赋予可识别的优质身份。可用性仍然取决于路由、配置和推出时间。

title_en: Here's Why Australia Canceled Its Order For F-35 Fighter Jets
title_zh: 这就是澳大利亚取消 F-35 战斗机订单的原因
summary: Australia has extended the life of its Super Hornets, allowing it to cancel its final order of F-35s with the option to buy them another day.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚延长了超级大黄蜂的使用寿命，允许其取消 F-35 的最终订单，并可以选择改日购买。
body_en: Aaron is an aviation enthusiast and world traveler with a deep interest in aerospace history and technology. He has traveled around the world numerous times, often incorporating visits to aviation museums and historic aircraft collections into his journeys. A native of New Zealand, he is an expert in aviation and maintains a broad interest in a variety of other subjects.

Australia has canceled (or, rather, paused) its planned purchase of a fourth squadron of Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II fighter jet aircraft. The F-35 is now fully operational in Australia and forms the backbone of the country's fighter jet capability . The door remains open for Australia purchasing a fourth squadron of F-35s, but the longer it's delayed, the more choice Australia will have in purchasing upcoming aircraft, like the Tempest/GCAP.

Australia's F/A-18 legacy Hornets have now been fully retired. Some of the legacy Hornets were sold to Canada, which used them for parts, as well as complete aircraft, to keep its aging fleet of legacy Hornets flying. For now, Australia will extend the life of its Super Hornets to keep operating into the 2040s through a series of upgrades, while spending the money saved on purchasing more munitions and other systems.
Australia Is Currently The Largest Export Customer

Australia received its final Lockheed Martin F-35 in December 2024. While it has a program of record for a total of 100 F-35s, it has only committed to purchasing 72 of them. Having received all 72, Australia is now the largest export customer of the F-35 in the world. It has more F-35s in service than the United Kingdom, which has received around 44 of its 48 contracted examples.

The UK is expected to place its next order soon. Italy has around 40 F-35s in service (both A and B models), while Israel has around 48 aircraft, of which none are known to be lost in the ongoing conflict with Iran. Japan is thought to have received over 40 aircraft, while Norway has become the first country to have completed its program of record for 52 F-35As.

Considering Australia's program of record for 100 F-35s, the only export customers with greater numbers are the UK, Japan, and Italy, with Australia receiving more of its aircraft faster. Most European countries have ordered around 50 or fewer F-35s, while Canada has a program of record for 88 F-35s.

Of these, 16 have been contracted, with the first now built. Canada is considering reducing its F-35 purchase due to geopolitical complications . The largest operators and customers for the F-35 are the US Air Force, US Marine Corps, and the US Navy. So far, Lockheed Martin has delivered around 1,300 F-35s of all variants to all customers.

With 72 F-35As in service, Australia now has three active F-35 squadrons. These are complemented by a fleet of 24 F/A-18 Super Hornets and 12 EA-18G Growlers . The Super Hornets were purchased as a stopgap measure to ensure there was no capability gap between Australia's now-retired F-111 Aardvark and legacy Hornets and the then-delayed F-35.

In April 2024, Australian Aviation reported that " the federal government has confirmed it has put on hold plans to buy a fourth squadron of F-35s and will instead redirect some of that investment towards long-range missiles ." The decision was taken after Australia decided to upgrade its existing Super Hornet fleet and keep them flying into the 2040s; previously, it had been intended to retire the Super Hornets by around 2027.

By delaying the retirement of the Super Hornet, Australia is able to free up funds to invest in more long-range missiles and other capabilities. In discussions about how many aircraft a country has, magazine depth, maintenance logistics, trained pilot depth, and available funds are often glossed over. These are critical to being able to effectively use the aircraft that an air force actually has.

Paradoxically, Australian Defence Industry Minister Pat Conroy said at the time that there were two main reasons for keeping the Super Hornets in service and to cancel or delay the fourth F-35 squadron. One reason was that the Super Hornets were " doing great work ." The second, and counterintuitive, reason was that the " Joint Strike Fighter [F-35] is even more capable than we initially thought ."

In other words, the F-35 is so advanced that Australia doesn't currently see the need to purchase more of them to reach the level of capabilities that it requires. The lower number of F-35s gives Australia the desired capability, taking pressure off purchasing more of them. Australia's squadron of Growlers is also significant. It is the only operator of dedicated electronic warfare aircraft outside of the United States Navy.

The Growlers are operated by No. 6 Squadron and are based at RAAF Base Amberley. It is unclear if the F-35s will eventually replace these aircraft, as the F-35 is now one of the world's formidable electronic warfare aircraft in its own right. In leaked Canadian (as well as prior Finnish) evaluations, the F-35 dramatically outperformed Super Hornets with Growlers and Gripens with GlobalEyes , even when operating alone.
More F-35s Could Yet Return To The Australian Fleet

In March 2025, the Australian Coalition pledged to acquire more F-35s if it won the Australian federal elections . It seemed that a Coalition government would boost the country's F-35s to 100 aircraft, in line with the country's program of record, and the first of these aircraft was expected to arrive by 2029. However, the Coalition dramatically lost the election.

Instead, the Labor Government returned to power, and it says the delay in Super Hornet retirement makes the F-35 purchase unnecessary. This shows there is still an appetite in Australia to acquire the remaining 28 F-35s for a fourth squadron. The Coalition believes they should be purchased now, while the Labor Government thinks the decision should be kicked down the road a few more years, as the Super Hornet retirement is delayed.

The Super Hornet remins a very capable and modern aircraft, and the US Navy is still purchasing them, with the last examples expected to roll off the assembly line in 2027. The US Navy doesn't plan to fully replace them until its F/A-XX enters service in enough numbers decades from now. However, by kicking the can down the road, more options for Australia emerge in the 2030s.
The Tempest/GCAP Offers An Alternative Super Hornet Replacement

Since the May 2025 elections in Australia, there doesn't appear to have been new reporting on the matter, and it seems that the government is sticking with its plan to keep the Super Hornets in service until the 2040s. As stated, this leaves the door open to ordering the remaining F-35s, although facts could change between now and then.
body_zh: 亚伦是一位航空爱好者和环球旅行家，对航空航天历史和技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他曾多次环游世界，经常在旅途中参观航空博物馆和历史飞机收藏。他是新西兰人，是航空专家，并对其他各种学科保持着广泛的兴趣。
澳大利亚已取消（或者更确切地说，暂停）购买洛克希德·马丁公司第四个 F-35 闪电 II 战斗机中队的计划。 F-35 现已在澳大利亚全面投入使用，并构成了该国战斗机能力的支柱。澳大利亚购买第四个 F-35 中队的大门仍然敞开，但推迟的时间越长，澳大利亚在购买即将推出的飞机（如 Tempest/GCAP）时就有更多选择。
澳大利亚的 F/A-18 遗留黄蜂队现已完全退役。一些旧款黄蜂机被出售给加拿大，加拿大将它们用作零部件以及整架飞机，以保持其老化的旧式黄蜂机队继续飞行。目前，澳大利亚将通过一系列升级来延长超级大黄蜂的寿命，使其继续运行到 2040 年代，同时将节省下来的资金用于购买更多弹药和其他系统。
澳大利亚是目前最大的出口客户
澳大利亚于 2024 年 12 月收到了最后一架洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-35。虽然该国的计划记录为总共 100 架 F-35，但它只承诺购买其中 72 架。澳大利亚已接收全部 72 架，现已成为全球最大的 F-35 出口客户。它的现役 F-35 数量比英国还多，英国已接收了 48 架合同飞机中的约 44 架。
预计英国将很快下达下一份订单。意大利有大约 40 架现役 F-35（A 型和 B 型），而以色列有大约 48 架飞机，其中没有一架在与伊朗的持续冲突中损失。据信日本已接收了 40 多架飞机，而挪威则成为第一个完成其创纪录的 52 架 F-35A 计划的国家。
考虑到澳大利亚记录的 100 架 F-35 计划，数量较多的唯一出口客户是英国、日本和意大利，其中澳大利亚接收更多飞机的速度更快。大多数欧洲国家订购了约 50 架或更少的 F-35，而加拿大则有 88 架 F-35 的计划。
其中 16 个项目已签订合同，第一个项目现已建成。由于地缘政治复杂性，加拿大正在考虑减少 F-35 采购。 F-35 最大的运营商和客户是美国空军、美国海军陆战队和美国海军。迄今为止，洛克希德·马丁公司已向所有客户交付了大约 1,300 架各种型号的 F-35。
澳大利亚目前拥有 72 架现役 F-35A，拥有三个现役 F-35 中队。此外还有 24 架 F/A-18 超级大黄蜂和 12 架 EA-18G 咆哮者机队。购买超级大黄蜂是作为权宜之计，以确保澳大利亚现已退役的 F-111 土豚和传统黄蜂以及当时推迟的 F-35 之间不存在能力差距。
2024 年 4 月，澳大利亚航空报道称，“联邦政府已确认已搁置购买第四个 F-35 中队的计划，并将部分投资转向远程导弹。”这一决定是在澳大利亚决定升级其现有的超级大黄蜂机队并让它们继续飞行到 2040 年代之后做出的；此前，超级黄蜂队曾计划在 2027 年左右退役。
通过推迟超级大黄蜂的退役，澳大利亚能够腾出资金来投资更多的远程导弹和其他能力。在讨论一个国家拥有多少架飞机时，弹药库深度、维护后勤、训练有素的飞行员深度和可用资金常常被掩盖。这些对于有效使用空军实际拥有的飞机至关重要。
矛盾的是，澳大利亚国防工业部长帕特·康罗伊当时表示，让超级大黄蜂继续服役和取消或推迟第四个F-35中队的组建有两个主要原因。原因之一是超级黄蜂队“做得很好”。第二个违反直觉的原因是“联合攻击战斗机 [F-35] 的能力比我们最初想象的还要强大。”
换句话说，F-35 非常先进，澳大利亚目前认为没有必要购买更多 F-35 来达到其所需的能力水平。 F-35 数量较少，为澳大利亚提供了所需的能力，减轻了购买更多 F-35 的压力。澳大利亚的咆哮者中队也很重要。它是美国海军以外唯一一家拥有专用电子战飞机的运营商。
咆哮者由第 6 中队运营，驻扎在澳大利亚皇家空军安伯利基地。目前尚不清楚 F-35 是否最终会取代这些飞机，因为 F-35 现在本身就是世界上最强大的电子战飞机之一。在泄露的加拿大（以及之前的芬兰）评估中，F-35 的性能显着优于带有咆哮者的超级大黄蜂和带有 GlobalEyes 的鹰狮，即使是单独操作时也是如此。
更多 F-35 可能会重返澳大利亚舰队
2025年3月，澳大利亚联盟党承诺，如果赢得澳大利亚联邦选举，将采购更多F-35。联盟政府似乎将按照该国的记录计划将该国的 F-35 飞机数量增加到 100 架，并且第一架飞机预计将于 2029 年抵达。然而，联盟党在选举中惨败。
相反，工党政府重新掌权，并表示超级大黄蜂退役的延迟使得购买 F-35 变得没有必要。这表明澳大利亚仍然有兴趣为第四中队购买剩余的 28 架 F-35。联盟党认为现在就应该购买它们，而工党政府则认为这一决定应该再推迟几年，因为“超级大黄蜂”的退役被推迟了。
超级大黄蜂是一种非常强大的现代化飞机，美国海军仍在采购它们，最后一批飞机预计将于 2027 年下线。美国海军不打算完全更换它们，直到几十年后其 F/A-XX 数量足够多时投入使用。然而，如果把这个问题搁置一旁，澳大利亚将在 2030 年代出现更多选择。
Tempest/GCAP 提供了超级大黄蜂的替代品
自澳大利亚 2025 年 5 月选举以来，似乎没有关于此事的新报道，而且政府似乎仍在坚持其让超级大黄蜂队服役到 2040 年代的计划。如上所述，这为订购剩余的 F-35 敞开了大门，尽管事实可能会随着时间的推移而发生变化。

title_en: Aer Lingus Completes Free Starlink Wi-Fi Rollout On Long Haul Fleet
title_zh: 爱尔兰航空在长途机队完成免费 Starlink Wi-Fi 部署
summary: Aer Lingus has installed free Starlink Wi-Fi on all 12 A330s and 14 A321s, finishing its long haul rollout well ahead of schedule. Short haul planes are next.
summary_zh: 爱尔兰航空已在所有 12 架 A330 和 14 架 A321 上安装了免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，提前完成了远程部署。短途飞机
body_en: In November 2025, International Airlines Group (IAG) announced plans to introduce free Starlink Wi-Fi across the brand’s airlines, including British Airways, Iberia, and Aer Lingus.

In March 2026, we saw Aer Lingus equip its first aircraft (an Airbus A330) with Starlink Wi-Fi. There’s now an exciting update for the airline, as all long haul planes now feature the service. That’s fantastic news for those traveling transatlantic on the airline.

Aer Lingus is partnering with SpaceX to introduce Starlink Wi-Fi throughout its fleet, including on long haul and short haul aircraft. Best of all, Aer Lingus is offering Starlink Wi-Fi for free for all passengers. With this system, it’s possible to connect with multiple devices, including laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

Aer Lingus doesn’t even require you to be a member of its loyalty program in order to use the service, which is an area where IAG carriers are (generously) countering the industry trend, as other airlines are using Starlink as a way to drive loyalty program sign-ups.

Starlink is known for its high-speed, low-latency broadband internet, and the service is offered gate to gate. Starlink Wi-Fi allows for live streaming, productivity similar to on the ground (with high upload and download speeds), gaming, e-commerce, and more. Starlink is becoming increasingly popular with airlines, and we’ve seen dozens of airlines sign up for the service. As a passenger who values staying connected, I find Starlink to be a game changer .

Aer Lingus has just revealed that it has now installed Starlink Wi-Fi on all of its long haul aircraft. This includes all 12 Airbus A330s, as well as all 14 Airbus A321s (including both the A321LR and A321XLR variants). That means that all of Aer Lingus’ long haul fleet now features Starlink Wi-Fi.

The airline deserve huge credit for that rollout pace. Initially the carrier was planning on having Starlink on all long haul flights by the first quarter of 2027, then the timeline was moved forward to the end of 2026, and now the project has been wrapped up before the end of October. Kudos!
That’s the beauty of Starlink, because the actual installation process is really quick, once planes are certified to have the service.

With long haul aircraft now reconfigured, the plan is for short haul aircraft operating within Europe to get Starlink next, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. The airline has a total of 27 Airbus A320s and eight Airbus A320neos, so once that project starts, I’d expect it to only take a few months to complete, at most.

Aer Lingus is in the process of rolling out free Starlink Wi-Fi, and has done an impressive job so far. At this point all long haul aircraft, including Airbus A330s, A321LRs, and A321XLRs, feature Starlink. This is well ahead of the planned timeline, which was supposed to see the project complete by the first quarter of 2027.

Next up we can expect to see short haul Aer Lingus planes get Starlink, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. Unlike non-IAG carriers, Aer Lingus isn’t requiring passengers to be a member of the loyalty program to connect to the service.
What do you make of Aer Lingus introducing free Starlink Wi-Fi?
body_zh: 2025 年 11 月，国际航空集团 (IAG) 宣布计划在该品牌旗下的航空公司（包括英国航空、西班牙国家航空和爱尔兰航空）推出免费 Starlink Wi-Fi。
2026 年 3 月，我们看到爱尔兰航空为其第一架飞机（空客 A330）配备了 Starlink Wi-Fi。该航空公司现在有一个令人兴奋的更新，因为所有长途飞机现在都提供该服务。对于乘坐该航空公司跨大西洋旅行的人来说，这是个好消息。
爱尔兰航空正在与 SpaceX 合作，在其机队中引入 Starlink Wi-Fi，包括长途和短途飞机。最重要的是，爱尔兰航空为所有乘客免费提供 Starlink Wi-Fi。通过该系统，可以连接多种设备，包括笔记本电脑、平板电脑和智能手机。
爱尔兰航空甚至不要求您成为其忠诚度计划的会员即可使用该服务，而 IAG 航空公司在这一领域（慷慨地）逆袭了行业趋势，因为其他航空公司正在使用 Starlink 作为推动忠诚度计划注册的方式。
Starlink 以其高速、低延迟宽带互联网而闻名，并且该服务是门到门提供的。 Starlink Wi-Fi 可实现直播、类似于地面的生产力（具有高上传和下载速度）、游戏、电子商务等。星链越来越受到航空公司的欢迎，我们已经看到数十家航空公司注册了该服务。作为一名重视保持联系的乘客，我发现 Starlink 改变了游戏规则。
爱尔兰航空刚刚透露，目前已在其所有长途飞机上安装了 Starlink Wi-Fi。这包括所有 12 架空客 A330 以及所有 14 架空客 A321（包括 A321LR 和 A321XLR 型号）。这意味着爱尔兰航空的所有长途机队现在都配备了 Starlink Wi-Fi。
该航空公司的推出速度值得高度赞扬。最初，该航空公司计划在 2027 年第一季度之前在所有长途航班上安装 Starlink，后来将时间表提前到 2026 年底，现在该项目已在 10 月底前完成。荣誉！
这就是星链的美妙之处，因为一旦飞机被认证可以提供这项服务，实际的安装过程非常快。
随着长途飞机现已重新配置，计划是让欧洲境内运营的短途飞机下一步接入星链，但具体时间表仍有待观察。该航空公司总共拥有 27 架空客 A320 和 8 架空客 A320neo，所以一旦该项目开始，我预计最多只需要几个月就能完成。
爱尔兰航空正在推出免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，迄今为止已经取得了令人印象深刻的成绩。目前，所有长途飞机，包括空客 A330、A321LR 和 A321XLR，都配备了 Starlink。这远远超出了计划时间表，该项目原定于 2027 年第一季度完成。
接下来，我们预计将看到爱尔兰航空的短途飞机接入星链，但具体时间仍有待观察。与非 IAG 航空公司不同，爱尔兰航空不要求乘客成为忠诚度计划的会员才能连接到该服务。

title_en: This Is How Fast A Cessna Grand Caravan Can Fly
title_zh: 这就是塞斯纳大篷车的飞行速度
summary: The Cessna Grand Caravan was never built for speed, but it flys fast enough to make it incredibly useful for a variety of scenarios
summary_zh: 塞斯纳大篷车从来不是为了速度而建造的，但它的飞行速度足够快，使其在各种场景中都非常有用
body_en: This Is How Fast A Cessna Grand Caravan Can Fly
Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

In an era of commercial aviation dominated by high-Mach sweepwings, transcontinental business jets, and fuel-efficient narrowbodies pushing past Mach 0.80, true utility aviation operates under an entirely different set of laws. For the pilots, safari operators, and remote-area logicians who rely on the Cessna Grand Caravan EX every day, raw velocity is never the primary design metric. Instead, the aircraft is engineered as an aerial workhorse, prioritizing short takeoff and landing (STOL) capabilities, massive payload versatility, and rugged-field endurance over absolute speed.

Textron Aviation publishes a maximum cruise speed of 185 knots true airspeed (KTAS), equivalent to roughly 213 miles per hour or 343 kilometers per hour, for the standard landplane configuration. How does this speed figure dictate the mission profile of the world's most prolific utility turboprop, and what forces govern its performance envelope?

The current iteration, the Cessna Grand Caravan EX, is powered by an 867-shaft-horsepower Pratt & Whitney PT6A-140 turboprop engine, as per Cessna . This engine has a significant performance leap over older legacy Caravan variants, which historically relied on the 675-shaft-horsepower PT6A-114A. The added thermodynamic power does not necessarily turn the Caravan into a speed demon, but it does let it maintain climb authority and stable cruise performance even at maximum gross weight in high-density-altitude environments.

In standard commercial configuration, the Grand Caravan EX carries a distinctive ventral cargo pod mounted beneath the fuselage. The external composite pod is essential for maximizing luggage, freight, and mail capacity, but it imposes unavoidable aerodynamic drag. Textron's published maximum cruise speed of 185 KTAS accounts for this standard cargo-pod configuration. In a clean configuration without the cargo pod, the aircraft can stretch its high-speed cruise closer to 195 KTAS, though nearly all commercial operators sacrifice those marginal knots to retain the unmatched utility of the underbelly storage.

The relationship between payload weight and true airspeed is remarkably linear in high-lift, high-drag utility designs. As operators load the cabin with up to nine passengers or dense commercial freight approaching its 3,532-pound useful load limit, flight crews manage fuel burn and torque settings to balance time-en-route efficiency against engine longevity.

The Grand Caravan EX's true brilliance shines the moment asphalt turns to gravel, mud, or grass. While light twin-engine aircraft or high-speed single-engine turboprops might outpace the Caravan by 50 to 100 knots in high-altitude cruise, they frequently fail when forced to land on unprepared backcountry airstrips. Cessna engineered the Caravan's high-wing, fixed-gear airframe to trade top-end speed for exceptional low-speed handling and short takeoff and landing (STOL) performance, according to Jettly .

At maximum takeoff weight (MTOW), the Grand Caravan EX needs a takeoff ground roll of just 1,399 feet, and its landing distance is similarly short, meaning bush pilots do not need multi-thousand-foot paved runways to operate safely. The aircraft's large Fowler flaps and docile stall characteristics let pilots bleed off airspeed quickly on final approach, descending steeply over obstacle-strewn jungle clearings or mountain passes at speeds typically between 75 and 85 knots.

The penalty for this slow-flight mastery is felt at cruising altitude. Fixed landing gear legs generate continuous form drag, and the thick wing profile optimized for high lift coefficients naturally increases parasite drag at higher speeds. Consequently, pushing the Caravan beyond its structural and aerodynamic cruise limits hurts fuel efficiency, cementing its identity as a low-and-medium-altitude utility platform rather than a high-altitude cruiser.

Speed and distance are inextricably linked in aviation, and the Grand Caravan EX's cruise velocity directly dictates its operational radius. Textron Aviation lists a maximum ferry range of 912 nautical miles under specific, highly controlled ferry-mission conditions with auxiliary fuel management. In standard commercial utility configurations, with full passenger payloads or heavy freight loads, the practical operating radius typically ranges from 300 to 500 nautical miles before factoring in mandatory IFR fuel reserves.

Fuel consumption for the 867-shp Pratt & Whitney PT6A-140 engine scales predictably with altitude and torque settings. During typical high-speed cruise profiles at 10,000 to 12,000 feet, the engine burns about 55 gallons of jet fuel per hour, according to Craft Charter . Operators often pull back power and fly at long-range cruise (LRC) speeds, around 140 to 150 KTAS, to conserve fuel on remote missions where aviation fuel supply chains are fragile or exceptionally costly.

This flexibility in speed management makes the Caravan an ideal regional connector. On short-hop island-hopping routes or multi-stop safari circuits where flight segments last less than 45 minutes, the time lost flying at 160 KTAS instead of 185 KTAS is negligible. Conversely, the fuel savings accumulated across thousands of annual flight hours protect the commercial margins of regional operators flying in remote corners of the globe.

Managing a utility turboprop through dynamic weather and congested regional airspace is tough, so advanced flight deck automation is needed to keep pilot workload manageable. Modern Grand Caravan EX variants replace the older instrument clusters with the fully integrated Garmin G1000 NXi avionics suite . With dual high-resolution primary flight displays and a central multi-function display, the glass cockpit provides real-time situational awareness, synthetic vision technology (SVT), and digital mapping.

In high-workload environments, such as executing an instrument approach into a remote Alaskan valley or navigating sudden convective weather over African savannahs, the G1000 NXi lets single-pilot crews calculate ground speed, wind correction angle, and time enroute with pinpoint accuracy. The system continuously computes true airspeed and density altitude, giving the pilot an immediate read on how environmental conditions are affecting aircraft performance.

Furthermore, integration with digital flight management systems enables optimized vertical navigation profiles. While the airframe itself may cruise at modest speeds, automated flight controls help ensure descents and arrivals are flown with optimal fuel burn and precise track adherence, reducing the cognitive friction of complex utility missions.
body_zh: 这就是塞斯纳大篷车的飞行速度
航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。

在一个以高马赫后掠翼飞机、跨大陆公务机和超过 0.80 马赫的节能窄体飞机为主导的商业航空时代，真正的通用航空在一套完全不同的法律下运作。对于每天依赖 Cessna Grand Caravan EX 的飞行员、狩猎操作员和偏远地区逻辑学家来说，原始速度从来都不是主要的设计指标。相反，该飞机被设计为空中主力，优先考虑短距起飞和着陆 (STOL) 能力、大量有效负载多功能性以及崎岖场地的耐力，而不是绝对速度。
德事隆航空公布的最大巡航速度为 185 节真实空速 (KTAS)，相当于标准陆地飞机配置的约 213 英里/小时或 343 公里/小时。这个速度数字如何决定世界上最多产的通用涡轮螺旋桨飞机的任务概况，以及什么力量控制其性能范围？
根据塞斯纳的说法，当前版本的塞斯纳大篷车 EX 由 867 轴马力的普惠 PT6A-140 涡轮螺旋桨发动机提供动力。该发动机比旧款 Caravan 型号具有显着的性能飞跃，后者过去依赖 675 轴马力 PT6A-114A。增加的热动力并不一定会使大篷车变成速度恶魔，但它确实让它保持爬升权威和稳定的巡航性能，即使在高密度海拔环境中的最大总重量下。
在标准商业配置中，Grand Caravan EX 在机身下方安装了独特的腹侧货舱。外部复合吊舱对于最大化行李、货运和邮件容量至关重要，但它会产生不可避免的空气动力阻力。德事隆公布的这一标准货舱配置的最大巡航速度为 185 KTAS。在没有货舱的干净配置中，飞机可以将其高速巡航延伸到接近 195 KTAS，尽管几乎所有商业运营商都会牺牲这些边际节数以保留下腹部存储的无与伦比的效用。
在高升力、高阻力的实用设计中，有效载荷重量和真实空速之间的关系非常线性。当运营商在机舱内装载多达 9 名乘客或密集的商业货物，接近其 3,532 磅的有用负载限制时，机组人员会管理燃油燃烧和扭矩设置，以平衡航路时间效率和发动机寿命。
当柏油路变成砾石、泥土或草地时，Grand Caravan EX 真正的光芒就会闪耀。虽然轻型双引擎飞机或高速单引擎涡轮螺旋桨飞机在高空巡航时可能比大篷车快 50 至 100 节，但当它们被迫降落在没有准备的偏远机场时，它们经常会失败。据 Jetly 称，塞斯纳设计了 Caravan 的高翼固定起落架机身，以最高速度换取卓越的低速操控性和短距起降 (STOL) 性能。
在最大起飞重量 (MTOW) 下，Grand Caravan EX 只需要 1,399 英尺的起飞地面滑跑，其着陆距离也同样较短，这意味着丛林飞行员不需要数千英尺的铺设跑道即可安全操作。该飞机的大型福勒襟翼和温顺的失速特性使飞行员能够在最后进近时快速降低空速，以通常在 75 至 85 节之间的速度在障碍物遍布的丛林空地或山口上陡峭下降。
这种慢速飞行的掌握会受到巡航高度的影响。固定起落架腿产生连续的形式阻力，并且针对高升力系数优化的厚翼型自然地增加了较高速度下的寄生阻力。因此，推动大篷车超出其结构和空气动力学巡航限制会损害燃油效率，巩固其作为中低空通用平台而不是高空巡洋舰的身份。
在航空领域，速度和距离密不可分，Grand Caravan EX 的巡航速度直接决定了其作战半径。德事隆航空列出了在具有辅助燃油管理的特定、高度受控的渡轮任务条件下的最大渡轮航程为 912 海里。在标准商业公用设施配置中，在满载乘客有效负载或重货运负载的情况下，在考虑强制 IFR 燃料储备之前，实际运行半径通常为 300 至 500 海里。

867 轴马力 Pratt & Whitney PT6A-140 发动机的燃油消耗可根据海拔高度和扭矩设置进行调整。根据 Craft Charter 的数据，在 10,000 至 12,000 英尺的典型高速巡航过程中，发动机每小时燃烧约 55 加仑喷气燃料。运营商通常会收回动力并以约 140 至 150 KTAS 的远程巡航 (LRC) 速度飞行，以在航空燃油供应链脆弱或极其昂贵的远程任务中节省燃油。
这种速度管理的灵活性使 Caravan 成为理想的区域连接器。在航程持续时间不超过 45 分钟的短途跳岛航线或多站游猎线路中，以 160 KTAS 飞行而不是 185 KTAS 飞行所损失的时间可以忽略不计。相反，每年数千飞行小时积累的燃油节省保护了在全球偏远角落飞行的支线运营商的商业利润。
在动态天气和拥挤的区域空域中管理通用涡轮螺旋桨飞机非常困难，因此需要先进的驾驶舱自动化来控制飞行员的工作量。现代 Grand Caravan EX 变体用完全集成的 Garmin G1000 NXi 航空电子套件取代了旧的仪表组。玻璃驾驶舱配备双高分辨率主飞行显示器和中央多功能显示器，提供实时态势感知、合成视觉技术 (SVT) 和数字地图。
在高工作量环境中，例如执行仪器进近偏远的阿拉斯加山谷或在非洲大草原上应对突然的对流天气，G1000 NXi 可以让单人飞行员精确计算地速、风校正角度和航路时间。该系统不断计算真实空速和密度高度，让飞行员立即了解环境条件如何影响飞机性能。
此外，与数字飞行管理系统的集成可实现优化的垂直导航剖面。虽然机身本身可以以适度的速度巡航，但自动飞行控制有助于确保下降和到达时以最佳的燃油燃烧和精确的航迹遵循性飞行，从而减少复杂实用任务的认知摩擦。

title_en: SAS Flight From JFK Turns Back Over Atlantic, Passengers Left To Find Hotels After Midnight
title_zh: 从肯尼迪国际机场起飞的 SAS 航班在大西洋上空折返，乘客在午夜后出发寻找酒店
summary: Passengers faced a long night of missing luggage, booking problems and hotel hunting.
summary_zh: 乘客们面临着行李丢失、预订问题和寻找酒店的漫长夜晚。
body_en: SAS Flight From JFK Turns Back Over Atlantic, Passengers Left To Find Hotels After Midnight

Luke has over a decade of experience as a travel writer and aviation analyst. As a passionate traveler based across the Middle East and Asia, Luke offers strong insights into the industry. Based in South East Asia.

Hundreds of passengers on an SAS flight from New York JFK Airport (JFK) to Copenhagen Airport (CPH) were left stranded at Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) well past midnight after their aircraft turned back over the Atlantic due to a technical issue. Passengers were left without new flight details or access to their checked bags, while SAS eventually told them to book their own hotels.

Flight SK916 — operated by an Airbus A330-300 that can seat up to 262 passengers — had spent more than three and a half hours in the air before landing at Newark. Passengers said they received very little information both during and after the diversion, before SAS emailed them asking them to arrange their own hotel rooms.

SK916 was scheduled to leave JFK at 6:55 PM local time on Friday, October 23, for an overnight flight to Copenhagen, and was due to arrive at 8:40 AM on Saturday. Flight tracking data shows that the aircraft departed at 7:24 PM, 29 minutes behind schedule. Passenger Michael Flarup — who was traveling home to Copenhagen with his son — wrote on X that he noticed the aircraft heading in the wrong direction on the in-flight map around two hours into the flight.
Diverted to Newark due to a possible technical fault

Passengers were then told by cabin crew that the captain would make an announcement, before they were informed that the aircraft had developed a technical issue and the pilots did not feel comfortable continuing across the Atlantic. The A330 landed at Newark at 10:58 PM after three hours and 34 minutes in the air, with fire trucks and ambulances waiting on the runway. However, a series of further problems after landing would make the ordeal even more difficult. Flarup said

"Safety comes first. But the handling of hundreds of stranded passengers afterwards really needs to be better. People need clear information and a way to get home, especially in the middle of the night."

Passengers reportedly waited around an hour at baggage claim before being told their luggage could not be removed from the aircraft. They were subsequently given a QR code to report missing bags, but SAS's system would not accept their reports because they had not reached their original destination.

They were then told to expect new flight details within a couple of hours. However, Flarup said several hours passed without an update before his booking disappeared from the SAS app altogether. By then, it was past midnight, before SAS emailed passengers asking them to arrange their own accommodation and offering reimbursement of up to $280 (€250) per room.

Flarup said he managed to book one of the last available hotel rooms in the area. However, he claims that many passengers were still stranded at Newark when he and his son left. After making several calls to SAS support, nobody was able to tell him where the family's two suitcases were or help him register them as missing.

SAS confirmed to Danish outlet TV 2 that the flight returned due to a possible technical fault , adding that the aircraft was being inspected in Newark. However, it did not elaborate on the nature of the technical fault or why the aircraft was sent to Newark instead of JFK. Tracking data shows the aircraft involved (registration: LN-RKR) flew to Copenhagen the following day as flight SK910. Simple Flying contacted SAS for comment on this incident, but a representative could not be reached before publication.
What EU Rules Say About Hotels And Compensation

Because SK916 was operated by a European airline and was bound for Copenhagen, it falls under the EU's air passenger rights regulation, EU261 . Under these rules, airlines must provide passengers with free hotel accommodation for overnight delays, along with transport between the airport and hotel.

They must also provide meals and refreshments in reasonable amounts for the waiting time. This duty of care applies regardless of the reason for the disruption. Passengers may also be entitled to $672 (€600) in compensation for cancellations or arrival delays of four hours or more on flights covering more than 3,500 kilometers.
body_zh: 从肯尼迪国际机场起飞的 SAS 航班在大西洋上空折返，乘客在午夜后出发寻找酒店
卢克拥有十多年的旅行作家和航空分析师经验。作为一名遍及中东和亚洲的热情旅行者，卢克对该行业提供了深刻的见解。总部位于东南亚。
午夜过后，SAS 一架从纽约肯尼迪机场 (JFK) 飞往哥本哈根机场 (CPH) 的航班因技术问题在大西洋上空折返，数百名乘客滞留在纽瓦克自由国际机场 (EWR)。乘客们没有新的航班详细信息，也无法获取托运行李，而 SAS 最终告诉他们自己预订酒店。
SK916 航班由空客 A330-300 运营，最多可容纳 262 名乘客，在空中飞行了三个半小时以上，才降落在纽瓦克。乘客们表示，在改道期间和改道之后，他们收到的信息很少，然后 SAS 给他们发了电子邮件，要求他们安排自己的酒店房间。
SK916 定于当地时间 10 月 23 日星期五下午 6:55 从肯尼迪机场出发，搭乘过夜航班飞往哥本哈根，预计于星期六上午 8:40 抵达。航班跟踪数据显示，飞机于晚上 7 点 24 分起飞，比原计划晚了 29 分钟。乘客迈克尔·弗拉普 (Michael Flarup) 正与儿子一起返回哥本哈根的家中，他在 X 上写道，他注意到飞机在飞行大约两小时后朝着飞行地图上的错误方向飞行。
由于可能的技术故障而转移到纽瓦克
随后，机组人员告诉乘客，机长将发布公告，然后又告知飞机出现了技术问题，飞行员对继续横渡大西洋感到不舒服。 A330 在空中飞行 3 小时 34 分钟后于晚上 10 点 58 分降落在纽瓦克，消防车和救护车在跑道上等候。然而，着陆后一系列进一步的问题将使考验变得更加困难。弗拉普说
“安全第一。但事后对数百名滞留乘客的处理确实需要更好。人们需要明确的信息和回家的方式，尤其是在半夜。”
据报道，乘客在行李领取处等待了大约一个小时，然后才被告知他们的行李无法从飞机上取出。随后，他们获得了一个二维码来报告行李丢失，但 SAS 的系统不会接受他们的报告，因为他们尚未到达原来的目的地。
然后他们被告知要在几个小时内获得新的航班详细信息。然而，弗拉普表示，几个小时过去了，没有任何更新，他的预订从 SAS 应用程序中完全消失。那时已过了午夜，SAS 向乘客发送电子邮件，要求他们自行安排住宿，并为每间客房提供高达 280 美元（250 欧元）的报销。
弗拉普说，他设法预订了该地区最后一批可用的酒店房间之一。然而，他声称，当他和儿子离开时，许多乘客仍然滞留在纽瓦克。在多次致电 SAS 支持人员后，没有人能告诉他家人的两个行李箱在哪里，也没有人能帮助他将它们登记为失踪。
SAS 向丹麦电视台 TV 2 证实，该航班因可能的技术故障而返航，并补充说该飞机正在纽瓦克接受检查。不过，它没有详细说明技术故障的性质，也没有详细说明为什么飞机被送往纽瓦克而不是肯尼迪机场。跟踪数据显示，涉事飞机（注册号：LN-RKR）于第二天以 SK910 航班飞往哥本哈根。 Simple Flying 联系了 SAS 请求对这一事件发表评论，但在发布之前未能联系到其代表。
欧盟关于酒店和补偿的规定
由于 SK916 由一家欧洲航空公司运营且飞往哥本哈根，因此它属于欧盟航空乘客权利法规 EU261 的管辖范围。根据这些规定，航空公司必须为过夜延误的乘客提供免费的酒店住宿，以及机场和酒店之间的交通。
他们还必须在等待期间提供合理数量的膳食和茶点。无论中断原因为何，此注意义务均适用。对于航程超过 3,500 公里的航班取消或抵达延误 4 小时或以上，乘客还有权获得 672 美元（600 欧元）的赔偿。

title_en: JetBlue Creditors Hire Advisers As Stock & Bonds Sink, Bankruptcy Looms
title_zh: 股票和债券下跌、破产迫在眉睫 捷蓝航空债权人聘请顾问
summary: A group of JetBlue's senior creditors has hired a financial adviser and law firm, while the airline's stock and bonds sink, making a Chapter 11 restructuring look increasingly likely.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空的一群高级债权人聘请了一家财务顾问和律师事务所，而该航空公司的股票和债券却下跌，根据美国破产法第 11 章规定进行了重新调整。
body_en: JetBlue seems to be inching ever-closer to a Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection filing. The airline hasn’t turned a profit since before the pandemic, and it seems like such a filing is inevitable, as debt will need to be restructured. The company’s CEO has promised it won’t happen in 2026, though I’d be shocked if it doesn’t happen in 2027. Along those lines, there’s a noteworthy update, as clearly there’s a recent vibe shift among creditors…
JetBlue creditors hire advisers as stock & bonds sink

The Wall Street Journal reports how a group of senior creditors to JetBlue is working with a financial adviser and law firm, as the airline grapples with cash burn and increased jet fuel prices. JetBlue’s stock is trading at new lows in recent days, and closed Friday at $2.62, well under 50% of where it was trading under three months ago.

Not only that, but bonds are trading down as well. The company’s $2 billion notes due in 2031 fell to 42 cents on the dollar earlier this week, compared to trading near 80 cents on the dollar earlier this month.

In a statement, JetBlue simply shared that the company “remains confident in its JetForward ​strategy and the progress being ​made ⁠toward returning to sustained profitability.” Of course that says nothing about the possibility of filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Quite to the contrary, a Chapter 11 filing is almost certainly a key part of what will allow the airline to have a chance of success in the long run.
JetBlue will be fine, but a restructuring is necessary

As mentioned above, JetBlue hasn’t turned a profit since before the start of the pandemic. The airline has also had a series of setbacks, ranging from its partnership with American being blocked by regulators, and then its merger with Spirit also being blocked by regulators. All the while, executives at the airline did nothing to actually improve the carrier’s independent prospects.
Fortunately that’s starting to change, as leadership increasingly puts effort into its TrueBlue program , introduces first class while reconfiguring planes more efficiently , and opens lounge .

I trust that JetBlue will eventually be fine. The issue is, the airline now has close to $9 billion in debt . So even if the airline could at some point turn an operating profit, servicing that amount of debt while being a relatively small carrier seems like a hurdle that’s not easy to overcome.

Just to put that into context, Delta only has about double as much debt as JetBlue, despite having around seven times as much revenue. Meanwhile Southwest has materially less debt than JetBlue, despite having more than three times as much revenue.

For years we’ve known that United is at least in theory interested in JetBlue in some form… mainly its presence at New York (JFK). While for a while it sure seemed like United wanted a merger with JetBlue , clearly management has decided against that with current debt levels. If JetBlue does enter bankruptcy protection, though, I wouldn’t be surprised if United is part of some long term deal.

A group of JetBlue creditors have hired advisers, as the carrier’s stock and bonds sink. JetBlue hasn’t been in a good spot in a long time, as the company hasn’t turned a profit since before the pandemic. But we’re getting to the point where JetBlue can’t keep reporting operating losses while also having such a big debt burden.

JetBlue’s CEO had promised there wouldn’t be a bankruptcy filing in 2026, but it seems like the goal has almost been to just wait and see if any airline tries for a merger. With the current debt levels, it seems that even United isn’t interested, but I imagine that could change once the carrier is in Chapter 11.
How do you see this JetBlue situation playing out?
body_zh: 捷蓝航空似乎越来越接近根据美国破产法第 11 章申请破产保护。自大流行之前以来，该航空公司一直没有实现盈利，而且这样的申请似乎是不可避免的，因为债务需要重组。该公司的首席执行官已承诺这不会在 2026 年发生，但如果在 2027 年不会发生，我会感到震惊。沿着这些思路，有一个值得注意的更新，因为债权人最近的态度显然发生了转变……
随着股票和债券下跌，捷蓝航空债权人聘请顾问
《华尔街日报》报道了捷蓝航空的一组高级债权人如何与财务顾问和律师事务所合作，以应对该航空公司面临的现金消耗和航空燃油价格上涨的问题。捷蓝航空的股​​价近几天创下新低，周五收盘价为 2.62 美元，远低于三个月前交易价格的 50%。
不仅如此，债券交易也在下跌。该公司 2031 年到期的 20 亿美元票据本周早些时候跌至 42 美分兑 1 美元，而本月初的交易价格接近 80 美分。
捷蓝航空在一份声明中简单地表示，该公司“对其 JetForward 战略以及在恢复持续盈利方面所取得的进展仍然充满信心”。当然，这并没有提及根据《破产法》第 11 章申请破产的可能性。恰恰相反，从长远来看，第 11 章备案几乎肯定是航空公司获得成功机会的关键部分。
捷蓝航空会没事，但需要重组
如上所述，捷蓝航空自疫情爆发前就尚未实现盈利。该航空公司也遭遇了一系列挫折，从与美国航空的合作关系被监管机构阻止，到与精神航空的合并也被监管机构阻止。一直以来，该航空公司的高管都没有采取任何措施来真正改善该航空公司的独立前景。
幸运的是，随着领导层越来越多地将精力投入到 TrueBlue 计划中，引入头等舱，同时更有效地重新配置飞机，并开设休息室，这种情况开始发生变化。
我相信捷蓝航空最终会没事的。问题是，该航空公司目前负债接近 90 亿美元。因此，即使该航空公司能够在某个时候扭亏为盈，作为一家规模相对较小的航空公司，偿还如此数额的债务似乎是一个不容易克服的障碍。
就具体而言，达美航空的债务仅为捷蓝航空的两倍左右，尽管其收入约为捷蓝航空的七倍。与此同时，尽管西南航空的收入是捷蓝航空的三倍多，但其债务却大大少于捷蓝航空。
多年来，我们都知道美联航至少在理论上对某种形式的捷蓝航空感兴趣……主要是其在纽约（肯尼迪机场）的业务。虽然有一段时间，联合航空似乎确实希望与捷蓝航空合并，但显然管理层已经决定根据当前的债务水平反对这一合并。不过，如果捷蓝航空确实进入破产保护，如果美联航成为某些长期交易的一部分，我不会感到惊讶。
随着捷蓝航空的股​​票和债券下跌，一群债权人聘请了顾问。捷蓝航空很长一段时间以来都处境不佳，因为该公司自疫情爆发之前就没有实现盈利。但我们已经到了这样的地步：捷蓝航空不能继续报告经营亏损，同时还背负着如此沉重的债务负担。
捷蓝航空首席执行官曾承诺 2026 年不会申请破产，但目标似乎只是观望是否有航空公司尝试合并。就目前的债务水平而言，似乎连美联航都不感兴趣，但我想一旦航空公司进入破产法第 11 章，这种情况可能会发生变化。
您如何看待捷蓝航空目前的情况？

body_en: Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045 - Aviation24.be
Home Manufacturers Airbus Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045

Airbus expects the worldwide dedicated freighter fleet to grow from 2,360 aircraft in 2026 to 3,460 by 2045, an increase of approximately 46%, driven by fleet replacement and expanding air cargo demand.

Its 2026 Cargo Global Market Forecast, presented at the Cargo Facts Symposium, estimates a requirement for 2,670 freighter deliveries over the period. Replacements will account for 1,580 aircraft, with a further 1,090 supporting growth.

Passenger-to-freighter conversions are expected to supply 1,700 aircraft, compared with 970 new-build freighters. By size, demand comprises 1,140 single-aisle aircraft, 860 medium widebodies and 670 large widebodies.

North America will lead demand with 925 deliveries, followed by Asia-Pacific with 850. Together, the regions represent approximately two-thirds of the total. Europe and the CIS will require 515 aircraft, Latin America 165, the Middle East 125 and Africa 90.

Airbus forecasts annual air cargo traffic growth of 3.2% over the next two decades, outpacing projected global trade growth of 2.9%. It identifies e-commerce, high-value technology shipments and the use of air freight as an alternative to maritime transport among the principal drivers.

Asia-Pacific is expected to remain the leading region for international air cargo traffic, with North American connections forming the largest market. Airbus sees opportunities for its A350F and passenger-to-freighter conversions across the A320, A321 and A330 families as operators replace older aircraft.

body_en: American posts record revenue but fuel costs drive third-quarter loss - Aviation24.be
American Airlines reported record third-quarter revenue of US$16.3 billion, up 19.3% year-on-year, but higher fuel costs pushed the group to a net loss of US$269 million.

The airline’s fuel bill increased by US$1.9 billion, or 67.5%, compared with the third quarter of 2025. Its adjusted net loss was US$182 million, while unit costs excluding fuel and special items rose by 3%.

Revenue growth extended across cabins and markets. Premium revenue increased by 22.9% and Main Cabin revenue by 19.5%, while total revenue per available seat kilometre rose by 14.5%. International passenger unit revenue grew by 16.4%, led by Latin America, ahead of a 13.6% increase domestically.

Business travel also remained strong, with managed corporate revenue rising by 27.6%, its sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Enrolments in the AAdvantage loyalty programme increased by 27.4%.

American is continuing investment in premium seating, lounges and onboard technology. It plans to extend Starlink connectivity across its entire mainline fleet of more than 1,000 aircraft and introduce seatback entertainment on new narrowbody deliveries from 2028. A narrowbody retrofit programme is intended to raise premium seating to 40% of seats in the coming years.
The group ended September with US$11.8 billion in available liquidity. It expects its efficiency programme to deliver nearly US$1 billion in annualised savings by the end of 2026.

For the fourth quarter, American forecasts revenue growth of 19.5–22.5%, but anticipates a further US$2.8 billion year-on-year increase in fuel expense, based on the forward fuel curve as of 19 October. Elevated fuel prices are also expected to slow network growth in 2027 compared with 2026.

title_en: How Airlines Got Away With Only Paying Flight Attendants Once The Boarding Door Closed
title_zh: 航空公司如何在登机门关闭后只向空乘人员支付费用
summary: A major bone of contention for flight attendants in the US.
summary_zh: 这是美国空乘人员争论的一个主要焦点。
body_en: How Airlines Got Away With Only Paying Flight Attendants Once The Boarding Door Closed

Writer - Patricia joins Simple Flying with over 20 years of experience in aviation. She has served as cabin crew on flights from economy-class through to first-class and on private jets as well as being head of cabin crew and cabin safety focal point. Patricia has a master's level postgraduate diploma in Human Factors in Aviation and has written about aviation since 2010. Based in Dubai/Cyprus.

It's long been known that flight attendants in the US have not been paid for boarding and other duties on the ground, a reality that has always been heavily debated. Flying has become more stressful, flights are busier than ever, and often flights have the minimum crew needed, putting additional stress on the crew.

The airlines insist that flight attendants are fully compensated, but still a fair amount of duties are conducted without pay. How did airlines get away with only paying flight attendants once the boarding door closed? How did the situation finally change? Let's find out in more detail.

Pay for flight attendants is based on "block time." At most major US airlines, flight attendants start earning their hourly flight pay only once all passengers have boarded, the door is closed, and the aircraft pushes back from the gate. That moment is called "block out," and pay stops when the door opens at the destination. So the time spent boarding, preparing the cabin, doing safety checks, and waiting through delays hasn't traditionally been paid at the regular hourly rate.

One flight attendant told NPR that the unpaid duties can total five or six hours a day, and that can include four or five boardings. According to Aerocorner , the median US flight attendant pay was $67,130 in May 2024, ranging from under $34,030 at the bottom tenth to over $138,040 at the top. Pay is calculated per flight hour rather than per hour worked, so boarding, disembarking, and gate delays have historically fallen outside the paid clock.

Most of a flight attendant's salary is block pay. This is supplemented by boarding pay (depending on the airline), reserve guarantee (being available on call), and per diem (meals and incidentals away from base). Duty or trip rigs are long days worked with little flying, which is paid at one hour for every two hours worked. When a flight attendant first starts flying for an airline, they are on reserve or standby to cover last-minute flights. There is no schedule, but there is a guarantee of 75 to 78 hours.

The Fair Labor Standards Act exempts employees of air carriers covered by the Railway Labor Act from federal overtime requirements. The Association of Flight Attendants argues this exemption, rather than the Railway Labor Act itself, is the core reason flight attendants aren't paid for every hour of their duty day. Airline workers have been exempt from those protections since the law was passed in 1938.

Alaska Airlines argues that flight attendants are fully compensated and said on its website, "Contrary to union narratives, we do pay flight attendants for boarding time through a pay mechanism that was negotiated with the union in previous contract cycles." That "pay mechanism" is a guarantee of minimum pay, says Sara Nelson, president of the Association of Flight Attendants, the union representing flight attendants at Alaska, United and a number of other airlines. She told NPR that it was common that there was a guarantee of one hour of paid flight time for every two hours on duty.

This can be further explained by saying that if a flight attendant has a day of 12 hours, they are guaranteed six hours of pay, even if not flying for those six hours. However, flying has changed since then, there are more seats on aircraft, unruly passengers are on the rise, and since 9/11, there have been threats to security. According to the Labor Department, flight attendants earn about $38,000 a year on the low end and close to $100,000 a year on the high end. A flight attendant in their first year earns close to the state minimum wage.

The idea has been that flight attendants are paid a higher hourly rate than they otherwise would be, to make up for the unpaid time on the ground. Contracts added protections like guaranteed minimums. A common one guarantees an hour of paid flight time for every two hours on duty. United Airlines ' contract, for example, has a minimum monthly pay floor that builds the unpaid ground time into higher hourly rates and these guarantees.

United’s published scale starts new flight attendants at $38.21 per flight hour and climbs with each year of service, with the top of the scale reaching $100.13 by 2030 under the current agreement. This sounds generous, but when actual flight hours are considered, and a full-time flight attendant line is 75 to 90 flight hours, it flattens the salary out. So, at $38.21 per hour multiplied by 80 flight hours a month, it is around $36,700 per year before per diem, boarding pay, and premiums.
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — live signals, no signup.

Today, many contracts include additional compensation (duty rigs, trip rigs, minimum day, holding pay, etc.) through negotiations between the unions and the airlines. The Association of Flight Attendants-CWA is one that is pushing to establish boarding pay as a new aviation industry standard.

On June 2, 2022, Delta Air Lines began paying flight attendants half their hourly rate for boarding, for a set 40 to 50 minutes depending on the aircraft and route. Delta's flight attendants aren't unionized , and the move was widely seen as an attempt to undercut an Association of Flight Attendants (AFA) drive to organize them. It also showed the old payment system could finally change. In April 2024, Southwest Airlines and TWU Local 556 members approved a four-year deal of 81 percent, with a 22.3 percent immediate raise plus premium pay for extended duty days and long ground time.

In September 2024, American Airlines flight attendants received 50% of their regular hourly rate for scheduled boarding times under their labor contract with the Association of Professional Flight Attendants (APFA). This boarding pay applies to each actual flight segment boarded and typically adds roughly $300 to $834 plus per month, depending on seniority and the number of legs worked.

Under the five-year labor contract ratified in May 2026, United Airlines flight attendants receive boarding pay calculated at 50% of their base hourly rate multiplied by the scheduled boarding duration for the operating aircraft type. The standard base hourly wage starts at $38.21 per flight hour. Boarding pay is paid based on the actual scheduled boarding time. The airline agreed to pay $741 million in retroactive pay, and sit pay for scheduled sits over two and a half hours.
body_zh: 航空公司如何在登机门关闭后只向空乘人员支付费用
作家 - Patricia 加入 Simple Flying 时拥有 20 多年的航空经验。她曾在从经济舱到头等舱的航班以及私人飞机上担任机组人员，并担任机组人员负责人和客舱安全协调员。 Patricia 拥有航空人为因素硕士学位研究生文凭，自 2010 年以来一直撰写有关航空的文章。居住在迪拜/塞浦路斯。
众所周知，美国的空乘人员没有获得登机和其他地面职责的报酬，这一现实一直备受争议。飞行变得越来越有压力，航班比以往任何时候都更加繁忙，而且航班通常只需要最少的机组人员，这给机组人员带来了额外的压力。
航空公司坚持要求空乘人员获得全额报酬，但仍有相当一部分工作是无薪执行的。登机门关闭后，航空公司是如何只向空乘人员付费的？最终情况如何发生变化呢？让我们更详细地了解一下。
空乘人员的工资是根据“阻塞时间”计算的。在美国大多数主要航空公司，空乘人员只有在所有乘客登机、舱门关闭、飞机从登机口推回时才开始赚取每小时的飞行工资。这一刻被称为“封锁”，当目的地门打开时，付款就会停止。因此，传统上，登机、准备机舱、进行安全检查和等待延误所花费的时间并不是按正常小时费率支付的。
一名空乘人员告诉美国国家公共广播电台，每天未付的职责可能总共有五到六个小时，其中可能包括四到五次登机。根据 Aerocorner 的数据，2024 年 5 月，美国空乘人员的薪资中位数为 67,130 美元，最低的十分之一不到 34,030 美元，最高的超过 138,040 美元。工资是按飞行小时计算的，而不是按工作小时计算的，因此登机、下机和登机口延误历来不属于付费时钟范围。
空乘人员的大部分工资都是集体工资。除此之外还有登机费（取决于航空公司）、储备金保证（随叫随到）和每日津贴（远离基地的膳食和杂费）。执勤或旅行装备是指长时间工作，很少飞行，每工作两小时按一小时支付工资。当空乘人员第一次开始为航空公司飞行时，他们会处于预备状态或待命状态，以赶上最后一刻的航班。没有时间表，但保证75至78小时。
《公平劳动标准法》免除了《铁路劳动法》所涵盖的航空公司员工的联邦加班要求。空乘人员协会认为，这项豁免，而不是《铁路劳工法》本身，是空乘人员没有按工作日每小时领取工资的核心原因。自 1938 年该法律通过以来，航空公司工作人员一直不受这些保护。
阿拉斯加航空公司辩称，空乘人员得到了全额报酬，并在其网站上表示，“与工会的说法相反，我们确实通过在之前的合同周期中与工会协商的薪酬机制向空乘人员支付登机时间的工资。”代表阿拉斯加航空公司、联合航空公司和其他一些航空公司空乘人员的工会空乘人员协会主席萨拉·尼尔森表示，这种“薪酬机制”是最低工资的保证。她告诉NPR，每执勤两小时就能保证一小时的带薪飞行时间，这种情况很常见。
这可以进一步解释为，如果空乘人员一天工作 12 小时，则保证他们有 6 小时的工资，即使这 6 小时没有飞行。然而，从那时起，飞行发生了变化，飞机上的座位更多了，不守规矩的乘客也在增加，而且自9/11以来，安全威胁不断出现。根据劳工部的数据，空乘人员的年薪低端约为 38,000 美元，高端则接近 100,000 美元。空乘人员第一年的收入接近州最低工资。
这个想法是，空乘人员的小时工资比原来更高，以弥补地面上的无薪时间。合同增加了保证最低限度等保护措施。普通的保证每执勤两小时就有一小时的带薪飞行时间。例如，美国联合航空公司的合同规定了每月最低工资，将未付的地面时间纳入更高的小时费率和这些保证中。
美联航公布的新空乘人员起薪为每飞行小时 38.21 美元，并随着服务年限的增加而不断攀升，根据目前的协议，到 2030 年最高限额将达到 100.13 美元。这听起来很慷慨，但当考虑到实际飞行时间时，全职空乘人员的飞行时间为 75 至 90 个小时，工资就被拉平了。因此，按每小时 38.21 美元乘以每月 80 个飞行小时，扣除每日津贴、登机费和保险费后，每年约为 36,700 美元。
紧急呼叫、等待、航行通告 — 实时信号，无需注册。
如今，许多合同都包括通过工会和航空公司之间谈判获得的额外补偿（执勤装备、旅行装备、最短工作天数、持有工资等）。空乘人员协会 (CWA) 正在推动将登机费制定为新的航空业标准。

2022 年 6 月 2 日，达美航空开始向空乘人员支付半小时的登机费，具体时间为 40 至 50 分钟，具体取决于飞机和航线。达美航空的空乘人员没有加入工会，此举被广泛视为试图削弱空乘人员协会 (AFA) 组织空乘人员的努力。这也表明旧的支付系统终于可以改变。 2024 年 4 月，西南航空和 TWU Local 556 成员批准了一项为期四年的 81% 协议，立即加薪 22.3%，外加延长值班日和长时间飞行时间的额外费用。
2024 年 9 月，美国航空空乘人员根据与专业空乘人员协会 (APFA) 签订的劳动合同，在预定登机时间获得正常小时工资的 50%。登机费适用于每个实际登机的航段，通常每月增加大约 300 至 834 美元，具体取决于资历和工作航段数。
根据2026年5月批准的五年期劳动合同，联合航空空乘人员的登机工资按其基本时薪的50%乘以运营机型的预定登机时间计算。标准基本时薪为每飞行小时 38.21 美元起。登机费按照实际预定登机时间支付。该航空公司同意支付 7.41 亿美元的追溯工资，并支付两个半小时以上的预定座位费用。

title_en: Sydney’s New $14 Billion Airport Officially Opens As First Jetstar Flight Takes Off
title_zh: 随着首架捷星航班起飞，悉尼耗资 140 亿澳元的新机场正式启用
summary: Western Sydney unveils a curfew free $14 billion hub with sold out inaugural Jetstar flight and freight services.
summary_zh: 西悉尼耗资 140 亿美元打造一个无宵禁枢纽，捷星航空的首个航班和货运服务已售罄。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

Sunday 25 October marks a special day for Sydneysiders, with the historic opening of a second Sydney international airport. Western Sydney International (Nancy-Bird Walton) Airport (WSI) opens to passenger flights today, after a $14 billion build and development from scratch.
The new airport plays a critical part in the city's and country's infrastructure, and is the first time a brand new airport has been built in Australia in more than half a century.

First Flight At Western Sydney Airport Departs To The Gold Coast

Jetstar was the first commercial operator with passenger flights to begin at Western Sydney Airport , as the Airbus A320 departed for the Gold Coast (OOL) at 11:22 AM under flight number JQ362 . Later this evening, Jetstar will begin its second new service to Western Sydney, with JQ375 scheduled to depart for Melbourne Airport (MEL) at 6:00 PM.

Jetstar has four planned routes from Western Sydney, with the Gold Coast and Melbourne becoming the first today, followed by Brisbane Airport (BNE) on Tuesday, October 27, and Denpasar (DPS) on March 15. Its parent company, Qantas, will begin operating under the QantasLink brand to both Brisbane and Melbourne from March 28.

Western Sydney is located around 27 miles (44km) from downtown Sydney , and just 20 minutes from Penrith. The new airport will operate curfew-free, meaning flights can arrive and depart 24 hours a day, seven days a week , in contrast to the city's main airport, which is restricted to daytime operations between 6:00 AM and 11:00 PM.
Air New Zealand To Become First International Operator Tomorrow

The first international airline to operate to Western Sydney will be Air New Zealand . The Star Alliance carrier will depart from Auckland Airport (AKL) on Monday, flying to Western Sydney up to three times a week. This will be the airline's seventh year-round destination in Australia after Adelaide, Brisbane, Gold Coast, Melbourne, Perth and Sydney, while seasonal services also operate to Cairns, Hobart and the Sunshine Coast.

The airport has already opened with regular freight services on July 27, with Qantas Freight operating alongside ASL Airlines and National Jet Express. Destinations include Adelaide, Brisbane, Cairns, Melbourne and Perth.

新机场在城市和国家的基础设施中发挥着至关重要的作用，是澳大利亚半个多世纪以来首次修建的全新机场。

捷星航空是第一家在西悉尼机场开始运营客运航班的商业运营商，其空客 A320 于上午 11:22 起飞前往黄金海岸 (OOL)，航班号为 JQ362。今晚晚些时候，捷星航空将开通第二条飞往西悉尼的新航班，JQ375 定于下午 6:00 出发飞往墨尔本机场 (MEL)。
捷星航空计划有 4 条从西悉尼出发的航线，其中黄金海岸和墨尔本今天成为第一条航线，随后是 10 月 27 日星期二飞往布里斯班机场 (BNE)，以及 3 月 15 日飞往登巴萨 (DPS)。其母公司澳洲航空将从 3 月 28 日开始以 QantasLink 品牌运营飞往布里斯班和墨尔本的航班。
西悉尼距离悉尼市中心约 27 英里（44 公里），距离彭里斯仅 20 分钟路程。新机场将实行无宵禁运营，这意味着航班可以每周 7 天、每天 24 小时起降，而城市主要机场则仅限于上午 6:00 至晚上 11:00 之间白天运营。
新西兰航空明天将成为首家国际运营商
新西兰航空将是第一家运营飞往西悉尼的国际航空公司。这家星空联盟航空公司将于周一从奥克兰机场 (AKL) 出发，飞往西悉尼，每周最多 3 班。这将是该航空公司继阿德莱德、布里斯班、黄金海岸、墨尔本、珀斯和悉尼之后在澳大利亚第七个全年运营的目的地，同时还运营飞往凯恩斯、霍巴特和阳光海岸的季节性航班。
其他已表示计划开通西悉尼航线的国际航空公司包括斐济航空、卡塔尔航空、新加坡航空和越捷航空。这些国际航空公司 WSI 计划的完整详情请参见下表

title_en: Qatar Airways Airbus A321LRs With Flat Bed Business Class Launching Soon
title_zh: 卡塔尔航空配备可平躺商务舱的空客 A321LR 即将推出
summary: Qatar Airways expects to take delivery of its first Airbus A321LR in the coming weeks, and we now know the 1-1 business class seat it will use.
summary_zh: 卡塔尔航空预计将在未来几周内接收第一架空客 A321LR，我们现在知道它将使用的 1-1 商务舱座椅。
body_en: In the coming months, Qatar Airways is expected to take delivery of its first Airbus A321LR, which will be the carrier’s first narrow body aircraft featuring latest generation interiors, including flat beds. We’ve known that the airline would introduce a “mini-Qsuite” type product, and we now have details of which seating platform the airline has selected.
Qatar Airways will take delivery of 10 Airbus A321LRs

Qatar Airways currently has a total of 50 factory fresh Airbus A321-family aircraft on order. This includes 10 A321LRs, and 40 A321neos — both of those are latest generation aircraft, with the A321LR featuring additional range.
The expectation is that the first A321LR will be delivered in the coming weeks, before the end of 2026. The 10 A321LRs should join the fleet pretty quickly, and will then be followed by the A321neos.

The A321LR has a maximum range of 4,000 nautical miles, so it can be used for many destinations in Europe, Africa, and Asia. Below is a map showing the rough range from Doha (though in reality it won’t be quite as far, accounting for winds, fuel reserves, etc.).

Now, for those paying close attention, I should acknowledge that Qatar Airways briefly flew six leased, all-economy A321neos , but those were just intended as a temporary solution, and are now flying for Sun PhuQuoc Airways, which is running an interesting operation .

Qatar Airways’ A321neo-family aircraft order goes back a long time, and involved a lot of drama. The order was first announced in 2011, then the airline reconfirmed and upsized it in 2017. However, then former Qatar Airways CEO Akbar Al Baker got into a fight with Airbus over A350 production quality, and refused to take delivery of any Airbus planes.

That turned into a massive court battle, which was eventually resolved . But in the process, Qatar Airways lost all of its Airbus delivery slots , which is why these planes are coming way later than initially expected .
Qatar Airways A321LRs get STELIA Aerospace OPERA seats

Qatar Airways has been promising all along that it would introduce some sort of a next generation flat bed business class product on its Airbus A321LRs. As you’d expect, business class seats on narrow bodies sometimes differ from those on wide bodies, due to differing cabin constraints.

So we now know which business class product Qatar Airways has selected for the A321LR. Executive Traveller quotes Qatar Airways CEO Hamad Ali Al-Khater as saying that the new business class product will be based on the STELIA Aerospace OPERA platform.

The expectation is that these planes will boast 16 business class seats, in a 1-1 configuration. This product offers reverse herringbone seats, and Qatar Airways plans to have doors at each seat as well, of course with its customized finishes.
The launch customer for the STELIA Aerospace OPERA platform was Air France on its A350s . However, that’s the wide body version of the seat, which is modified from the narrow body version.
When it comes to the narrow body version of the STELIA Aerospace OPERA platform, ITA Airways was the launch customer, on its A321neos .

This is also the product that Etihad is installing on its A321LRs . ITA Airways and Etihad don’t have doors in business class, but Qatar Airways does plan to offer it. Etihad also markets the first row of the cabin as first class (and that has doors), but I wouldn’t expect Qatar Airways to do something similar.
This is about as good as narrow body business class seats get, as it’s generally preferred to the herringbone seats you’ll find on other carriers, like JetBlue A321LRs , American A321XLRs , etc.

In the coming weeks, Qatar Airways is expected to take delivery of its first of 10 Airbus A321LRs. This will be the first custom designed next generation narrow body that the airline takes delivery of. We knew the airline would offer flat bed seats on these planes, and now we have the details of that.

The airline has gone with the STELIA Aerospace OPERA platform, the same product you’ll find on similar planes of Etihad and ITA Airways. However, unlike those airlines, Qatar Airways will have doors in business class.
What do you make of Qatar Airways’ upcoming A321LRs, and the planned interiors?
body_zh: 在未来几个月内，卡塔尔航空预计将接收其首架空客 A321LR，这将是该公司第一架采用最新一代内饰（包括平躺床）的窄体飞机。我们知道该航空公司将推出“​​mini-Qsuite”型产品，现在我们已经了解了该航空公司选择的座位平台的详细信息。
卡塔尔航空将接收 10 架空客 A321LR 飞机
卡塔尔航空目前总共订购了 50 架出厂新空客 A321 系列飞机。其中包括 10 架 A321LR 和 40 架 A321neo——这两架飞机都是最新一代飞机，其中 A321LR 具有更大的航程。
预计第一架 A321LR 将在未来几周内（即 2026 年底之前）交付。这 10 架 A321LR 应该很快就会加入机队，然后是 A321neo。
A321LR的最大航程为4000海里，因此可用于欧洲、非洲和亚洲的许多目的地。下面的地图显示了从多哈出发的大致范围（尽管考虑到风、燃料储备等因素，实际上不会那么远）。
现在，对于那些密切关注的人，我应该承认卡塔尔航空公司短暂地飞行了六架租赁的全经济型 A321neo，但这些只是作为临时解决方案，现在正在为 Sun PhuQuoc Airways 飞行，该航空公司正在进行一项有趣的运营。
卡塔尔航空的 A321neo 系列飞机订单可以追溯到很久以前，并且涉及很多戏剧性的事情。该订单于2011年首次宣布，随后于2017年再次确认并扩大了订单规模。然而，时任卡塔尔航空首席执行官阿克巴尔·阿尔·贝克(Akbar Al Baker)与空客就A350的生产质量发生争执，并拒绝接收任何空客飞机。
这变成了一场大规模的法庭斗争，最终得到了解决。但在此过程中，卡塔尔航空失去了所有空客的交付时段，这就是为什么这些飞机的抵达时间比最初预期要晚得多。
卡塔尔航空 A321LR 获得 STELIA Aerospace OPERA 座位
卡塔尔航空一直承诺将在其空客 A321LR 上推出某种下一代平板商务舱产品。正如您所料，由于客舱限制不同，窄体飞机的商务舱座椅有时与宽体飞机的商务舱座椅有所不同。
现在我们知道卡塔尔航空为 A321LR 选择了哪种商务舱产品。 Executive Traveler 援引卡塔尔航空首席执行官 Hamad Ali Al-Khater 的话说，新的商务舱产品将基于 STELIA Aerospace OPERA 平台。
预计这些飞机将拥有 16 个商务舱座位，采用 1-1 布局。该产品提供反向人字形座椅，卡塔尔航空还计划在每个座椅上安装门，当然还有定制的饰面。
STELIA Aerospace OPERA 平台的启动客户是法国航空 A350 飞机。不过，那是宽体版的座椅，是由窄体版改装而成的。
当谈到 STELIA Aerospace OPERA 平台的窄体版本时，ITA Airways 是 A321neos 的首发客户。
这也是阿提哈德航空在其 A321LR 上安装的产品。 ITA 航空和阿提哈德航空没有商务舱，但卡塔尔航空确实计划提供商务舱。阿提哈德还将第一排客舱定位为头等舱（并且有门），但我不认为卡塔尔航空会做类似的事情。
这与窄体商务舱座椅一样好，因为它通常比您在其他航空公司（如捷蓝 A321LR、美国 A321XLR 等）上找到的人字形座椅更受青睐。
在未来几周内，卡塔尔航空预计将接收其 10 架空客 A321LR 中的第一架。这将是该航空公司接收的第一架定制设计的下一代窄体飞机。我们知道航空公司会在这些飞机上提供平躺座椅，现在我们了解了详细信息。
该航空公司采用了 STELIA Aerospace OPERA 平台，您可以在阿提哈德航空和 ITA 航空的类似飞机上找到相同的产品。然而，与这些航空公司不同的是，卡塔尔航空将开设商务舱。
