title_en: New Qatar Airways Qsuite Next Gen Business Class Launching Mid-2027, But Not As Planned
title_zh: 卡塔尔航空全新 Qsuite 下一代商务舱将于 2027 年中期推出，但未按计划推出
summary: Qatar Airways' Qsuite Next Gen business class has been delayed by 777X problems, so the airline now plans to debut it on the Airbus A350-1000 in mid-2027.
summary_zh: 卡塔尔航空的 Qsuite Next Gen 商务舱因 777X 问题而被推迟，因此该航空公司目前计划于 2 年中在空客 A350-1000 上首次推出该服务
body_en: In July 2024, Qatar Airways unveiled its newest business class product, which will be known as Qsuites Next Gen. While the initial plan was for this to be installed as of late 2025, that timeline didn’t stick, due to delivery delays with the Boeing 777X. There’s an update, as Qatar Airways now intends to debut this product on the Airbus A350, as of mid-2027. Let’s cover all the details.
Qatar Airways plans new business class product

Qatar Airways is known for its Qsuites business class . This is one of the world’s best business class experiences , between an excellent soft and hard product. Nearly 10 years after the product was introduced, it’s available on most long haul aircraft , but not all. Even though this continues to be one of the world’s most incredible business class experiences, that’s not stopping the airline from innovating.

Qatar Airways plans to introduce Qsuite Next Gen, its newest long haul business class experience. This product is evolutionary rather than revolutionary, which isn’t surprising, when you consider how good Qatar Airways’ product already is. However, the improvements are substantial, and I have to imagine that this will easily be the world’s overall best business class experience.

The Qsuite Next Gen business class cabin has the same general layout as the current product, which is to say that it’s in a staggered configuration, alternating between being forward and rear facing. However, there are some significant improvements, which will be especially great for those traveling together.
Here are some of the highlights of what’s changing

A new movable 4K OLED Panasonic Astrova inflight entertainment screen, which can be repositioned to the side to create the largest social and productivity space in the sky, for up to four passengers in the Quad Suite, and up to two passengers in the Companion Suite
New customization options, including ambient lighting, privacy controls, and a touchscreen passenger control unit
A larger lie flat seat, as well as a large double bed
Added privacy, with taller, digitally controlled dividers
New storage, including enclosed drawers where you can store your phone, watch, jewelry, etc.
Significantly improved tech, including new wireless charging
Below you can see a video and some pictures highlighting some of the features of the new Qsuite Next Gen experience.
With more space, personalization and comfort than ever before.
Welcome to Qsuite Next Gen. Luxury redefined. #QatarAirways #WorldsBestAirline pic.twitter.com/EawbsNji4o
Qatar Airways Qsuite Next Gen rollout schedule

Initially, Qatar Airways’ plan was to introduce the Qsuite Next Gen business class product on the Boeing 777-9. The airline has at least 60 of these planes on order , and when the product was unveiled mid-2024, the plan was for deliveries to start as of late 2025.

As you’d expect, that timeline has been pushed back considerably, as the 777X still isn’t certified . Currently, Qatar Airways expects to take delivery of its first 777X in late 2027, best case scenario… and that could easily be delayed again! We should also see a new first class product debut on these planes (or at least a subfleet of them).

However, with the continued 777X delays, the airline is developing a new plan. Executive Traveller quotes Qatar Airways CEO Hamad Ali Al-Khater as saying that Qsuite Next Gen will now debut in mid-2027, on the Airbus A350-1000. Specifically, the plan is that the remaining (roughly one dozen) A350 deliveries will feature these new cabins as of then.

This is the first time that we’ve heard of any plane other than the 777-9 getting the Qsuite Next Gen product, so that’s exciting. However, this will only create even more product inconsistency, since there don’t seem to be plans to retrofit existing A350-1000s, at least as of now.
body_zh: 2024 年 7 月，卡塔尔航空推出了其最新的商务舱产品，该产品将被称为 Qsuites Next Gen。虽然最初计划是在 2025 年末安装该产品，但由于波音 777X 的交付延迟，该时间表并未遵守。有一个更新，卡塔尔航空现在打算从 2027 年中期开始在空客 A350 上首次推出该产品。 Let’s cover all the details.
卡塔尔航空计划推出新的商务舱产品
卡塔尔航空以其 Qsuites 商务舱而闻名。这是世界上最好的商务舱体验之一，介于卓越的软硬产品之间。该产品推出近 10 年后，大多数长途飞机都配备了该产品，但并非全部。尽管这仍然是世界上最令人难以置信的商务舱体验之一，但这并没有阻止航空公司的创新。
卡塔尔航空计划推出 Qsuite Next Gen，这是其最新的长途商务舱体验。该产品是渐进式的，而不是革命性的，当你考虑到卡塔尔航空的产品已经有多好时，这并不奇怪。然而，改进是巨大的，我不得不想象这将很容易成为世界上整体上最好的商务舱体验。
Qsuite Next Gen商务舱的总体布局与现有产品相同，也就是说，它采用交错配置，前向和后向交替。然而，有一些重大改进，这对于一起旅行的人来说尤其有用。
以下是一些变化的亮点：
全新可移动 4K OLED 松下 Astrova 机上娱乐屏幕，可重新定位到侧面，打造空中最大的社交和生产力空间，四人套房中最多可容纳 4 名乘客，伴侣套房中最多可容纳 2 名乘客
新的定制选项，包括环境照明、隐私控制和触摸屏乘客控制单元
更大的平躺座椅以及一张大双人床
通过更高的数字控制隔板增加隐私
新的存储空间，包括封闭式抽屉，您可以在其中存放手机、手表、珠宝等。
显着改进的技术，包括新的无线充电
您可以在下面看到一段视频和一些图片，其中重点介绍了新的 Qsuite Next Gen 体验的一些功能。
拥有比以往更多的空间、个性化和舒适度。
欢迎来到 Qsuite Next Gen，重新定义奢华。 #QatarAirways #WorldsBestAirline pic.twitter.com/EawbsNji4o
— 卡塔尔航空 (@qatarairways) 2024 年 7 月 22 日
卡塔尔航空 Qsuite Next Gen 推出时间表
最初，卡塔尔航空的计划是在波音 777-9 上推出 Qsuite Next Gen 商务舱产品。该航空公司至少订购了 60 架此类飞机，该产品于 2024 年中期推出时，计划于 2025 年末开始交付。
正如您所料，由于 777X 仍未获得认证，该时间表已被大幅推迟。目前，卡塔尔航空预计将在 2027 年底接收其首架 777X，这是最好的情况……而这很容易再次推迟！我们还应该看到新的头等舱产品在这些飞机（或至少其中的一个子机队）上首次亮相。
然而，随着 777X 的持续延误，该航空公司正在制定新计划。 Executive Traveler 援引卡塔尔航空首席执行官 Hamad Ali Al-Khater 的话说，Qsuite Next Gen 将于 2027 年中期在空客 A350-1000 上首次亮相。具体来说，计划是剩余的（大约十几架）A350 交付将配备这些新客舱。

title_en: Why The A350-1000 Is Gaining The Popularity Airbus Wished It Would A Decade Ago
title_zh: 为什么 A350-1000 如此受欢迎 空中客车公司十年前就希望如此
summary: The aircraft is gaining ground as Boeing's 777X slips further behind schedule, reshaping the battle for long-haul dominance.
summary_zh: 随着波音 777X 的进度进一步落后，这款飞机正在取得进展，重塑了长途航线主导地位的争夺战。
body_en: Why The A350-1000 Is Gaining The Popularity Airbus Wished It Would A Decade Ago

Passionate about promoting aviation, the beauty of flight and the science behind it, Antonio is an avid reader of aviation magazines and books, and he loves visiting airshows all over the world, taking photos and writing about airplanes and helicopters as well. He is currently based in Palermo, Sicily.

Airbus spent most of the last decade watching its largest twinjet play second fiddle to an aircraft that had not yet carried a single paying passenger. The Airbus A350-1000 entered service with Qatar Airways in 2018, yet for years it lived in the shadow of the Boeing 777-300ER and, later, the Boeing 777X , which Boeing promised for 2020. That delivery is now targeted for 2027, about seven years late, and the market has finally started to move. By June, Airbus data showed the A350-1000 had 367 orders and 114 deliveries, a far healthier position than its sluggish early sales ever suggested.

The key question is why demand has picked up now, rather than when the aircraft entered service, and whether the momentum will last. Air Canada , Riyadh Air , Philippine Airlines and even Emirates have all been pulled toward the type, while Airbus studies a stretched version that could challenge Boeing's largest jet head-on. Understanding the shift means looking first at why the A350-1000 struggled early, then at how Boeing's delays rewrote the buying logic, and finally at what Airbus might do with its sudden leverage.
The A350-1000 Faced An Uphill Battle From The Start

Airbus launched a strong aircraft into a market where many airlines already knew what they wanted. The 777-300ER had been the benchmark for large, long-range twinjets for years, and carriers looking for more than 350 seats on demanding routes had little reason to switch. The A350-1000 offered higher fuel efficiency and a newer composite airframe, but it arrived with a modest order book and no obvious must-have customer beyond its launch operator, Qatar Airways. Airlines also tend to favor evolutionary choices, and the larger A350 looked like a familiar design stretch rather than a leap.

Boeing's pitch made the choice harder still. The 777X, with its larger capacity and folding wingtips that let it fit standard gates, was positioned as the natural heir to the 777-300ER, and many carriers simply decided to wait. According to One Mile At A Time , Emirates planned to rely almost exclusively on the 777X for fleet renewal and had a total of 205 aircraft on order. An airline with that kind of commitment had little incentive to buy the Airbus alternative, however efficient it was. The 777X date kept sliding, and the A350-1000 was left to sell on its own merits.

Those merits were real, but so was a lingering worry about the Rolls-Royce engines, and sales stayed slow while Airbus kept building the aircraft anyway. The delay has left the market asking how much longer Boeing's schedule can slip, and what that means for Airbus.

The 777X was meant to enter service in 2020 and is now targeted for 2027, roughly seven years late. That has left Emirates unable to count on the program for growth, according to One Mile At A Time. For airlines with aging 777-300ERs, that gap is not abstract. Every extra year of delay means another year of older aircraft , higher fuel prices and heavier maintenance . Boeing also carries a reputational cost, since a program that slips year after year hands its rival a standing sales argument.

The delay has also changed the competitive balance. In its comparison of the 777-9 and the A350-1000, the delay has already decided half the market in Airbus' favor . Airbus has kept selling throughout. By mid-November 2025, A350-1000 orders for the year had reached 77, after Airbus' monthly update, and the backlog ended 2025 at 258 aircraft, according to ePlaneAI .

Financiers notice this momentum because lenders and lessors rely on appraisal overviews, such as the one in American Airlines' 2026 Form 424B5 filing with the SEC, to judge how aircraft hold their value, and a jet that can be delivered is easier to value than one still awaiting certification. In that sense, the A350-1000's rising order count is not only a sales story but also a statement about perceived risk.

Air Canada offers the clearest example of the shift. In February 2026, the carrier placed a firm order for eight A350-1000s, with rights to eight more. Simple Flying previously explored why the airline chose them over the 777X to replace its 777-300ERs. The deal secures delivery slots from the second half of 2030, which shows how long the queue for large twinjets has become. For a carrier retiring long-serving 777-300ERs, a firm delivery date mattered more than a bigger aircraft on paper.

Riyadh Air and Philippine Airlines have also placed orders recently, that Etihad Airways and Philippine Airlines have shown real enthusiasm for the type while other carriers remain cautious, according to ePlaneAI. Even Emirates, which had publicly criticized the Trent XWB-97 engines, was in advanced talks for at least 30 A350-1000s in late 2025, One Mile At A Time reported. That is a remarkable turn for an airline that had built its fleet strategy around the 777X. A trend emerged: carriers that once treated the A350-1000 as a niche choice now see it as a way to secure capacity on a predictable timeline.
Emirates' reported change of heart points to the A350-1000's main selling point: a combination of economics and availability, rather than novelty. Its specifications help explain why that matters.
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — live signals, no signup.
The A350-1000 Combines Long Range With Immediate Availability

Range is one clear advantage. The A350-1000 is listed at roughly 8,700 nautical miles (16,100 km), while the 777-9 is rated for about 7,285 nautical miles (13,492 km), a difference of about 1,400 nautical miles (2,600 km), according to The Flying Engineer's 2026 comparison. That edge matters on thin ultra-long routes, where airlines want a large aircraft without payload restrictions. The A350-1000 is already in production, with more than 100 delivered, while the 777-9 is still awaiting its first customer handover. For buyers such as Air Canada and Riyadh Air, that certainty of availability is a selling point in itself.
body_zh: 为什么 A350-1000 如此受欢迎 空中客车公司十年前就希望如此
安东尼奥热衷于推广航空、飞行之美及其背后的科学，是航空杂志和书籍的狂热读者，他喜欢参观世界各地的航展，也喜欢拍摄有关飞机和直升机的照片和撰写有关飞机和直升机的文章。他目前居住在西西里岛巴勒莫。

过去十年的大部分时间里，空中客车公司都在看着其最大的双发喷气式飞机在尚未搭载过一名付费乘客的飞机上屈居次席。空客 A350-1000 于 2018 年开始在卡塔尔航空公司服役，但多年来它一直生活在波音 777-300ER 和后来的波音 777X 的阴影下，波音承诺在 2020 年交付。现在交付的目标是 2027 年，大约晚了七年，但市场终于开始发生变化。截至 6 月，空中客车公司的数据显示，A350-1000 已获得 367 架订单和 114 架交付，这比其早期销售低迷所暗示的状况要健康得多。
关键问题是为什么需求现在而不是飞机投入使用时回升，以及这种势头是否会持续。加拿大航空、利雅得航空、菲律宾航空甚至阿联酋航空都已转向该机型，而空中客车公司则在研究一种加长版本，可能会正面挑战波音最大的喷气式飞机。理解这一转变意味着首先要了解 A350-1000 为何早期陷入困境，然后了解波音的延误如何改写了购买逻辑，最后了解空中客车公司可能会利用其突然的影响力采取什么行动。
A350-1000 从一开始就面临着一场艰苦的战斗

空中客车公司向市场推出了一款功能强大的飞机，许多航空公司已经知道自己想要什么。多年来，777-300ER 一直是大型远程双发喷气式飞机的标杆，在要求较高的航线上寻求 350 个以上座位的航空公司没有理由更换。 A350-1000 提供了更高的燃油效率和更新的复合材料机身，但它的订单量不大，除了其发射运营商卡塔尔航空公司之外，没有明显的必备客户。航空公司也倾向于支持进化选择，更大的 A350 看起来像是熟悉的设计延伸，而不是飞跃。

波音公司的宣传让这个选择变得更加困难。 777X 具有更大的容量和适合标准登机口的折叠翼尖，被定位为 777-300ER 的天然继承者，许多航空公司只是决定等待。据《One Mile At A Time》报道，阿联酋航空计划几乎完全依靠 777X 进行机队更新，总共订购了 205 架飞机。具有这种承诺的航空公司几乎没有动力购买空客的替代方案，无论它的效率如何。 777X 的日期不断下滑，而 A350-1000 则只能依靠自己的优点来销售。
这些优点是真实的，但对劳斯莱斯发动机挥之不去的担忧也是如此，尽管空客仍在继续制造飞机，但销售仍然缓慢。这次延误让市场询问波音的时间表还能推迟多久，以及这对空客意味着什么。
777X 原定于 2020 年投入使用，现在计划于 2027 年投入使用，大约晚了七年。据“一次一英里”称，这使得阿联酋航空无法指望该计划来实现增长。对于拥有老化 777-300ER 的航空公司来说，这种差距并不是抽象的。每延误一年，就意味着飞机又要旧一年、燃油价格更高、维护工作也更繁重。波音公司还承受着声誉成本，因为年复一年下滑的项目给其竞争对手带来了长期的销售争论。
延迟也改变了竞争平衡。在对 777-9 和 A350-1000 的比较中，延误已经决定了空客一半的市场。空中客车公司始终保持销售。 ePlaneAI 的数据显示，截至 2025 年 11 月中旬，空客每月更新后，全年 A350-1000 订单已达到 77 架，而 2025 年的积压订单数量为 258 架。
金融家注意到了这一势头，因为贷款人和出租人依赖评估概览（例如美国航空向 SEC 提交的 2026 年 424B5 表格中的评估概览）来判断飞机如何保持其价值，而一架可以交付的飞机比仍在等待认证的飞机更容易估值。从这个意义上说，A350-1000 订单数量的增加不仅是一个销售故事，也是一个关于感知风险的声明。

加拿大航空提供了这种转变最明显的例子。 2026 年 2 月，该航空公司下了 8 架 A350-1000 的确定订单，并拥有另外 8 架的权利。 Simple Flying 之前曾探讨过为什么该航空公司选择它们而不是 777X 来取代其 777-300ER。该交易确保了从 2030 年下半年开始的交付时间，这表明大型双发喷气式飞机的排队时间有多长。对于一家退役长期服役的 777-300ER 的航空公司来说，确定的交付日期比纸面上更大的飞机更重要。

据 ePlaneAI 称，利雅得航空和菲律宾航空最近也下了订单，阿提哈德航空和菲律宾航空对该机型表现出了真正的热情，而其他航空公司则保持谨慎态度。据《一次一英里》报道，就连曾公开批评遄达 XWB-97 发动机的阿联酋航空也在就 2025 年末购买至少 30 架 A350-1000 进行高级谈判。对于一家围绕 777X 制定机队战略的航空公司来说，这是一个非凡的转变。出现了一种趋势：曾经将 A350-1000 视为利基选择的航空公司现在将其视为在可预测的时间内确保运力的一种方式。
阿联酋航空报告的态度变化指出了 A350-1000 的主要卖点：经济性和可用性的结合，而不是新颖性。它的规格有助于解释为什么这很重要。
紧急呼叫、等待、航行通告 — 实时信号，无需注册。
A350-1000 将远距离与即时可用性相结合

范围是一项明显的优势。根据 The Flying Engineer 2026 年的比较，A350-1000 的额定航程约为 8,700 海里（16,100 公里），而 777-9 的额定航程约为 7,285 海里（13,492 公里），相差约 1,400 海里（2,600 公里）。这种优势对于细长的超长航线很重要，因为航空公司需要一架没有有效载荷限制的大型飞机。 A350-1000 已投入生产，已交付 100 多架，而 777-9 仍在等待第一批客户移交。对于加拿大航空和利雅得航空等买家来说，可用性的确定性本身就是一个卖点。

title_en: How Qatar Airways Is Rebalancing Its US East Coast Flying After American Airlines Quit Doha
title_zh: 美国航空退出多哈后，卡塔尔航空如何重新平衡其美国东海岸航班
summary: The reasoning behind Qatar Airways' recent network adjustments in the US, and why American Airlines pulled out of Doha.
summary_zh: 卡塔尔航空最近在美国调整网络的原因，以及美国航空退出多哈的原因。
body_en: How Qatar Airways Is Rebalancing Its US East Coast Flying After American Airlines Quit Doha

Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

The airline industry is going through a difficult and unpredictable time right now. Middle Eastern airlines, which have emerged over the past two decades as some of the world's largest and best international carriers, are most affected by the ongoing war in Iran. Their hubs were previously known as economically attractive and insulated from regional conflicts but have now found themselves in the line of fire, and this is leading to interesting developments in the industry.

In one instance, American Airlines suspended its route from Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) to Doha Hamad International Airport (DOH) when the war broke out, and then later announced that the DOH route wouldn't come back. However, Philadelphia customers need not fear loss of Middle Eastern service, as Qatar Airways now operates its own route from PHL to DOH. At the same time, the airline will soon cut back its third nonstop frequency between Doha and New York.

American Airlines temporarily suspended its nonstop route to DOH when the Iran War broke out, and confirmed its permanent cancellation in June. American first began serving DOH, its only Middle Eastern destination at the time, in 2022 from New York JFK Airport and then switched its US port to Philadelphia the following year. Doha is not nearly as large a city as Dubai, while neither American's New York JFK nor Philadelphia hubs are particularly huge, but the main reason for this route is connectivity with fellow one world member Qatar Airways.

Qatar Airways formerly flew to Philadelphia with its own metal before American took over the route, and as the two have a codeshare agreement, the route essentially continued as normal but with an American Boeing 787. At this same time, Qatar Airways also added a third nonstop frequency between DOH and JFK that would operate four times per week, bringing weekly frequencies to JFK from 14 to 18 flights per week. This schedule would persist until the war, with permanent adjustments coming later in the summer.

In August, Qatar Airways began daily flights between Doha and Philadelphia with an Airbus A350, while it will be ending its third JFK flight at the end of October. This is essentially the carrier reallocating capacity to what it flew before American Airlines began flying to Doha, and it comes during a point when foreign airlines are generally avoiding the Middle East, while the local carriers (including Qatar Airways) have largely restored their pre-war schedules. Of course, now is far from the most predictable time in the industry.

One way that airlines worldwide have been impacted by the conflict is higher fuel prices, which have nearly doubled compared to a year ago. In the Middle East, airspace restrictions have increased congestion and flight times. However, destinations like Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, and more had become major destinations in their own right; before the war, United served Dubai from Newark, and Delta announced nonstop flights to Riyadh, while Air Canada also flew to Dubai. Today, none of these flights are operating.

Attacks on Middle Eastern airports mean that there's an elevated risk of aircraft being damaged and airline crew being injured. Carriers operating to Middle Eastern cities are facing significantly higher insurance premiums due to the added risk, while labor unions (including those at the North American airlines) usually have strong objections to permitting layovers or turnarounds at these spokes. What's more, most airlines operating long-haul flights (including the North American carriers) don't have a huge presence in the Middle East, making it high-risk and low-reward.

The local carriers like Qatar Airways need to maintain their pre-existing schedules to the best of their ability, especially because a major part of the selling point is their global networks and competitive schedules. As a whole, it's critical for these airlines to still maintain service to as many destinations as possible, but it's much harder for foreign carriers to justify these routes today. Most airlines have been pushing back their restart dates, and American won't come back at all for now.

As it stands, Qatar Airways now serves 12 destinations in the US: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas/Fort Worth, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York-JFK, Philadelphia, San Francisco, Seattle, and Washington. It's notably the only Middle Eastern airline serving Philadelphia, and this airport is important for Qatar Airways because of its relationship with American Airlines. Philadelphia serves as American's primary transatlantic hub, which means that the airline also has a substantial connecting network to feed these flights.

Because of the partnership between American and Qatar, the flight between Philadelphia and Doha benefits from feed in Philadelphia as well as in Doha; it essentially functions as a long-haul hub-to-hub flight, regardless of which airline operates it. The same is true for Qatar Airways' flights to Chicago, Dallas-Fort Worth, Los Angeles, Miami, and New York JFK, as these are also hubs for American Airlines .

Ultimately, this is a small adjustment for the one world airline in response to American pulling out of Doha. This ensures that Philadelphia still has a nonstop link to Doha, and the airline is also trimming capacity in its largest US spoke as the summer season ends and travel begins to slow down. More interesting, however, is American's decision to permanently discontinue the Doha route, especially as American is otherwise looking to expand its long-haul network.

body_zh: 美国航空退出多哈后，卡塔尔航空如何重新平衡其美国东海岸航班
Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
航空业目前正在经历一段困难且不可预测的时期。中东航空公司在过去二十年中已成为世界上最大、最好的国际航空公司之一，但受伊朗持续战争的影响最大。它们的枢纽以前被认为具有经济吸引力并且不受地区冲突的影响，但现在发现自己处于火线之中，这导致了该行业有趣的发展。
例如，战争爆发时，美国航空暂停了从费城国际机场 (PHL) 飞往多哈哈马德国际机场 (DOH) 的航线，随后宣布不再恢复 DOH 航线。然而，费城的乘客不必担心失去中东服务，因为卡塔尔航空现在运营着自己的从 PHL 到 DOH 的航线。与此同时，该航空公司很快将削减多哈和纽约之间的第三个直飞航班。
伊朗战争爆发后，美国航空暂停了飞往卫生部的直飞航线，并于 6 月确认永久取消。美国航空于 2022 年首次从纽约肯尼迪机场开始为当时唯一的中东目的地 DOH 提供服务，然后于次年将其美国港口改为费城。多哈的城市规模远不如迪拜，而美国航空的纽约肯尼迪机场和费城枢纽机场都不是特别大，但这条航线的主要原因是与同为世界成员的卡塔尔航空的连通性。
在美国航空接管这条航线之前，卡塔尔航空此前曾使用自己的金属飞往费城，由于两家公司达成了代码共享协议，该航线基本上继续正常运营，但使用的是美国波音 787。与此同时，卡塔尔航空还增加了第三个往返于 DOH 和肯尼迪国际机场之间的直达航班，每周运营四班，使每周飞往肯尼迪国际机场的航班频率从 14 班增至 18 班。这个时间表将持续到战争结束，并在夏季晚些时候进行永久性调整。
8 月，卡塔尔航空开始使用空客 A350 执飞多哈和费城之间的每日航班，并将于 10 月底结束其第三次肯尼迪航班。这本质上是航空公司在美国航空开始飞往多哈之前重新分配运力，而此时外国航空公司普遍避开中东，而当地航空公司（包括卡塔尔航空公司）已基本恢复了战前的航班时刻表。当然，现在还远不是行业最可预测的时期。
全球航空公司受到冲突影响的一个原因是燃油价格上涨，与一年前相比几乎翻了一番。在中东，空域限制增加了拥堵和飞行时间。然而，迪拜、多哈、阿布扎比、利雅得等目的地本身已成为主要目的地；战前，美联航从纽瓦克飞往迪拜，达美航空宣布直飞利雅得，而加拿大航空也有飞往迪拜的航班。今天，这些航班都没有运营。
对中东机场的袭击意味着飞机受损和机组人员受伤的风险更高。由于风险增加，飞往中东城市的航空公司面临着高得多的保险费，而工会（包括北美航空公司的工会）通常强烈反对允许在这些枢纽中途停留或周转。此外，大多数运营长途航班的航空公司（包括北美航空公司）在中东地区的业务并不多，因此风险高、回报低。
像卡塔尔航空这样的当地航空公司需要尽其所能维持其现有的时刻表，特别是因为其主要卖点是其全球网络和有竞争力的时刻表。总体而言，对于这些航空公司来说，仍然保持飞往尽可能多的目的地的服务至关重要，但如今外国航空公司要证明这些航线的合理性要困难得多。大多数航空公司都在推迟重启日期，而美国航空目前根本不会回来。
目前，卡塔尔航空目前飞往美国 12 个目的地：亚特兰大、波士顿、芝加哥、达拉斯/沃斯堡、休斯顿、洛杉矶、迈阿密、纽约肯尼迪机场、费城、旧金山、西雅图和华盛顿。值得注意的是，它是唯一一家为费城提供服务的中东航空公司，并且由于与美国航空的关系，该机场对于卡塔尔航空而言非常重要。费城是美国航空的主要跨大西洋枢纽，这意味着该航空公司还拥有庞大的转机网络来满足这些航班的需求。
选择一架飞机，看看现在有多少架飞机在空中
由于美国航空和卡塔尔之间的合作关系，费城和多哈之间的航班受益于费城和多哈的航班；它本质上是一个长途枢纽到枢纽的航班，无论是哪家航空公司运营的。卡塔尔航空飞往芝加哥、达拉斯沃斯堡、洛杉矶、迈阿密和纽约肯尼迪机场的航班也是如此，因为这些也是美国航空的枢纽。

夏威夷航空（代码共享）、捷蓝航空（代码共享）
归根结底，这是寰宇一家航空公司为应对美国航空退出多哈而做出的小幅调整。这确保了费城仍然有直飞多哈的航班，而且随着夏季结束、旅行开始放缓，该航空公司也在削减其美国最大辐条区的运力。然而，更有趣的是美国航空决定永久停止多哈航线，特别是因为美国航空正在寻求扩大其长途网络。

body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. summary: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017

body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. 型护卫舰。英国国防部长约翰·希利表示，该交易超出了飞机采购范围。 “这是我们两国之间不断发展的国防和工业伙伴关系的前沿，”他说。作为访问的一部分，斯塔默还参观了土耳其航空航天工业公司的设施，在那里他参观了本土的卡恩战斗机。他还接触了 Hurjet 高级喷气教练机，该教练机是英国皇家空军 (RAF) 库存中 BAE Systems Hawk 喷气教练机的潜在替代者。该协议经过了三年的谈判，其中包括在埃尔多安政府逮捕了伊斯坦布尔市长埃克雷姆·伊马莫格鲁后，游说德国政府要求柏林解除对欧洲战斗机销售的限制，后者被视为埃尔多安在即将举行的选举中的严重总统竞争对手。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨(Friedrich Merz)政府取消了制裁，部分原因是这对德国工业有利。英国和土耳其政府于 7 月就欧洲战斗机销售达成了一份谅解备忘录。土耳其对这款飞机的兴趣部分是因为在 2030 年代生产出先进版本的卡恩飞机之前，需要在过渡期间提供更强大的空战平台。与此同时，安卡拉决定选择欧洲战斗机，是因为在因购买俄罗斯防空系统而面临美国制裁以及被排除在 F-35 联合攻击战斗机计划之外后，供应来源多样化的需要。阿曼和卡塔尔飞机向土耳其的转移引发了人们对卡塔尔额外欧洲战斗机订单未来的疑问，长期以来，卡塔尔的欧洲战斗机订单一直与另外 12 架飞机的订单有关，总计 36 架。与此同时，阿曼似乎希望以洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-16 Block 50 为中心巩固其战斗机机队。在 BAE Systems 的 2023 年全年业绩中，该公司透露，阿曼空军已选择不为其续签支持安排。台风，目前尚不清楚该舰队现在的活跃程度。购买这些额外的飞机意味着土耳其的机队将混合三种配置。卡塔尔的飞机配备了 Mk.0 版本的有源电子扫描阵列欧洲通用雷达系统 (ECRS) 雷达，而阿曼的飞机配备了机械扫描 Captor 传感器。除了欧洲战斗机订单外，埃尔多安和斯塔默还透露，他们正在制定一项新的贸易和安全协议。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 文章类型 文章 主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者托尼·奥斯本 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 从列表中排除？没有标签： 土耳其 、 欧洲战斗机台风 、 BAE 系统 、 MBDA 门控 ASD 特色图片 Typhoon_1600px.jpg title_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机“莲花计划”揭晓
summary: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototy
summary_zh: 莲花计划，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机揭晓 hockensmithawi…
body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. body_en: EHang VT35 william.moore@… Tue, 07/29/2025 - 08:58 The VT35 is an autonomous lift-plus-cruise eVTOL being developed by EHang. The first prototype VT35 has completed final assembly and is now undergoing flight testing, with the first public flight occurring in December 2025. Certification will be with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC), as with EHang’s EH216-S, and certification is expected to be accelerated owing to the company’s experience certifying the previous model. Structure and Powertrain The VT35 seats two passengers inside a cabin featuring panoramic viewing windows. It features eight distributed lift propellers on tandem wings for vertical takeoff and landing—four facing upward and four downward—and an aft-mounted pusher prop for cruise flight. Each fan is individually powered by it’s own electric motor. Distributed electric propulsion (DEP) is the name given to this method of powering aircraft. title_en: Boeing 737 MAX Cockpit: What Pilots See & Do On Every Flight
title_zh: 波音 737 MAX 驾驶舱：飞行员在每次飞行中看到和做的事情
summary: Legacy is no more apparent than within the cockpit of the Boeing 737 MAX, taking an original, time-tested design and bringing it into the future
summary_zh: 在波音 737 MAX 的驾驶舱内，传承的痕迹最为明显，采用经过时间考验的原创设计并将其带入未来
body_en: Boeing 737 MAX Cockpit: What Pilots See & Do On Every Flight
Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

Taking the first steps onto the flight deck of a Boeing 737 MAX can trigger a powerful sense of familiarity for pilots transitioning from the trusted Next-Generation (NG) series. The familiar overhead panel layout, iconic yokes, and throttle quadrant seem largely unchanged. However, this visual comfort conceals a fundamental transformation in how flight crews interact with onboard avionics and manage information flow.

When Boeing engineered the MAX to compete in the modern narrowbody landscape, upgrading the cockpit was not just about cosmetic modernization. Boeing saw it as shifting data management into the digital age while preserving a delicate type-rating lineage. So what do pilots actually see and do from the left and right seats? In reality, four massive landscape displays, repositioned controls, and subtle system overhauls completely redefine every phase of a flight.

The single most striking visual departure from older 737 generations is the total restructuring of the instrument panel. Gone are the six smaller, square display units that characterized the 737NG flight deck since the late 1990s. In their place sits a clean, expansive arrangement of four massive 15.1-inch landscape Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) screens supplied by Collins Aerospace , using advanced display architecture adapted directly from the 787 Dreamliner .

Operationally, the leap in screen technology and size greatly changes how flight crews consume primary flight and navigation data. On older NG aircraft, individual mechanical gauges, such as the flap position indicator and backup clocks, needed their own dedicated panel space. The MAX digital suite consolidates these traditional elements directly onto the primary flight displays and engine-indicating and crew-alerting system (EICAS) screens.

Flight crews now monitor engine parameters, primary flight data, and navigational maps rendered in crisp, high-resolution color fidelity that adapts seamlessly to ambient cockpit lighting. By merging multiple data streams onto unified glass screens, Boeing and Collins Aerospace removed visual clutter, letting captains and first officers scan critical aircraft states instantly without shifting focus across fragmented analog clusters.

The outer display units now house primary flight and navigation data, and the central workspace between the captain and first officer equally underwent significant ergonomic surgery. On older 737s, auxiliary instrumentation and landing gear controls were scattered across vertical panel sections , requiring pilots to reach across distinct boundaries during high-workload procedures like takeoff and landing, as illustrated by The Boeing 737 Technical Site.

To establish symmetry and improve accessibility, Boeing repositioned the core controls. The landing gear handle and the Integrated Standby Flight Display (ISFD) now sit squarely in the central gap between the inboard display screens. This deliberate shift gives both pilots equal visual access and reach to the backup flight instruments and gear actuation lever during emergency maneuvers or instrument failures.

Further down the console, additional control layouts reflect modern operational efficiencies. The autobrake rotary selector, multifunction display (MFD) controls, and brake pressure indicators migrated down toward the lower center console, sitting neatly between the flight management computers (FMCs). Meanwhile, the autobrake panel moved forward on the lower center console, directly in front of the thrust levers, streamlining the flow needed during rejected takeoffs or wet-runway landings.

In day-to-day operations, the expanded display surface unlocks high-definition situational awareness tools that were previously unavailable or severely restricted on older 737 generations. The main advancement for pilots is the Vertical Situation Display (VSD) , which shows a real-time profile of the aircraft's altitude relative to terrain, approach glidepaths, and waypoint altitude constraints directly beneath the horizontal navigation map. The VSD replaces complex mental calculations during steep descents into mountainous airfields or congested airspace, giving crews a continuous visual trajectory vector.

In addition to the main instrument panel displays, many commercial operators equip the captain's station with a Collins Head-Up Guidance System (HGS) . Projecting flight paths, airspeed vectors, and runway alignment cues onto a glass combiner plate in the pilot's forward line of sight, the HGS lets captains fly Category III low-visibility approaches to tight decision heights without losing visual contact with the outside world. According to Air International Magazine , this hardware integration gives crews flying dense short-haul routes precision schedule reliability even in severe weather conditions.

Deploying these sophisticated avionics tools makes a huge difference to how pilots manage energy states during high-density arrivals. By integrating vertical profile planning and head-up guidance directly into active scan patterns, flight crews can easily adapt to the differences between older narrowbody handling and modern NextGen air traffic management requirements, ensuring greater precision and fuel efficiency across every descent profile.
Commonality Across The Old And New Generation

Resolving the tension between modern digital avionics and fleet commonality meant Boeing had to design the MAX flight deck around strict type-rating continuity with the 737NG. For major international operators, preserving a shared type rating lets flight crews transition between the 737NG and the 737 MAX without lengthy, expensive full-type qualification programs in full-flight simulators. As Simple Flying previously explored , this commonality lets airlines maintain mixed-fleet rosters and dispatch pilots onto either aircraft type based on daily operational needs.

For this seamless transition to work, flight crews undergo approved differences training, which focuses strictly on the revised display interfaces and software logic rather than core flying techniques. As documented in WeFly pilot reports , the FAA and EASA mandate computer-based training modules alongside targeted simulator sessions to familiarize pilots with the EICAS layout, relocated gear handles, and altered system switches. Despite the massive 15.1-inch glass screens, basic cockpit flows, pre-flight checklists, and overhead panel switch positions remain identical to the NG, so muscle memory built over thousands of flight hours transfers directly to the MAX.
body_zh: 波音 737 MAX 驾驶舱：飞行员在每次飞行中看到和做的事情
航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。
对于从值得信赖的下一代 (NG) 系列过渡的飞行员来说，踏上波音 737 MAX 驾驶舱的第一步可以引发强烈的熟悉感。熟悉的顶置面板布局、标志性的轭架和油门象限似乎基本没有变化。然而，这种视觉舒适度掩盖了机组人员与机载航空电子设备交互和管理信息流方式的根本转变。
当波音公司设计 MAX 以在现代窄体飞机领域竞争时，驾驶舱的升级不仅仅是外观现代化。波音公司认为它将数据管理转变为数字时代，同时保留了微妙的类型评级血统。那么飞行员从左右座位上实际上能看到什么、做什么呢？事实上，四个巨大的景观显示器、重新定位的控制装置和微妙的系统检修完全重新定义了飞行的每个阶段。
与前代 737 相比，最引人注目的视觉差异是仪表板的整体重组。自 20 世纪 90 年代末以来，737NG 飞行甲板上的六个较小的方形显示单元已经不复存在。取而代之的是由柯林斯航空航天公司提供的四个巨大的 15.1 英寸横向液晶显示器 (LCD) 屏幕，采用直接从 787 梦想飞机改编而来的先进显示架构，排列整齐、宽敞。
在操作上，屏幕技术和尺寸的飞跃极大地改变了机组人员使用主要飞行和导航数据的方式。在较旧的 NG 飞机上，单独的机械仪表（例如襟翼位置指示器和备用时钟）需要自己的专用面板空间。 MAX 数字套件将这些传统元素直接整合到主飞行显示器以及发动机指示和机组警报系统 (EICAS) 屏幕上。
飞行机组人员现在可以监控发动机参数、主要飞行数据以及以清晰、高分辨率的色彩保真度呈现的导航地图，无缝适应驾驶舱环境照明。通过将多个数据流合并到统一的玻璃屏幕上，波音和柯林斯航空航天公司消除了视觉混乱，让机长和副驾驶可以立即扫描关键的飞机状态，而无需将注意力转移到分散的模拟集群上。
外部显示单元现在包含主要的飞行和导航数据，机长和副驾驶之间的中央工作区同样经过了重大的人体工程学手术。在较旧的 737 飞机上，辅助仪表和起落架控制装置分散在垂直面板部分，要求飞行员在起飞和着陆等高工作量程序中跨越不同的边界，如波音 737 技术站点所示。
为了建立对称性并提高可达性，波音重新定位了核心控制装置。起落架手柄和集成备用飞行显示器（ISFD）现在正好位于内侧显示屏之间的中央间隙中。这种有意的转变使两名飞行员在紧急操纵或仪表故障期间能够平等地视觉接触并触及备用飞行仪表和起落架致动杆。
在控制台下方，额外的控制布局反映了现代操作效率。自动制动旋转选择器、多功能显示器 (MFD) 控制装置和制动压力指示器向下移动至下部中控台，整齐地位于飞行管理计算机 (FMC) 之间。与此同时，自动制动面板在下部中控台上向前移动，位于推力杆的正前方，简化了起飞失败或湿跑道着陆时所需的气流。
在日常操作中，扩展的显示表面可解锁高清态势感知工具，而这些工具以前在老款 737 上无法使用或受到严格限制。对于飞行员来说，主要的进步是垂直情况显示（VSD），它可以在水平导航地图正下方显示飞机相对于地形的高度、进场滑行道和航路点高度限制的实时轮廓。在陡峭下降到山区机场或拥挤空域时，VSD 取代了复杂的心理计算，为机组人员提供了连续的视觉轨迹矢量。
除了主仪表板显示屏外，许多商业运营商还为机长站配备了柯林斯平视引导系统 (HGS)。 HGS 将飞行路径、空速矢量和跑道对准提示投射到飞行员前方视线中的玻璃组合板上，使机长能够以 III 类低能见度进场飞行至严格的决策高度，而不会失去与外界的视觉接触。据《国际航空杂志》报道，这种硬件集成使飞行密集短途航线的机组人员即使在恶劣的天气条件下也能实现精确的计划可靠性。
部署这些复杂的航空电子工具对飞行员在高密度到达期间管理能量状态的方式产生巨大影响。通过将垂直剖面规划和平视引导直接集成到主动扫描模式中，机组人员可以轻松适应旧式窄体飞机处理和现代下一代空中交通管理要求之间的差异，确保每个下降剖面都有更高的精度和燃油效率。
老一代和新一代的共性

解决现代数字航空电子设备和机队通用性之间的紧张关系意味着波音公司必须围绕与 737NG 严格的型号评级连续性来设计 MAX 飞行甲板。对于主要国际运营商来说，保留共享型号评级可以让机组人员在 737NG 和 737 MAX 之间进行转换，而无需在全飞行模拟器中进行冗长、昂贵的全型号资格认证计划。正如 Simple Flying 之前探索的那样，这种共性使航空公司能够维持混合机队名册，并根据日常运营需求将飞行员派遣到任一机型上。

为了实现无缝过渡到工作，机组人员接受了批准的差异培训，该培训严格关注修改后的显示界面和软件逻辑，而不是核心飞行技术。正如 WeFly 飞行员报告中所述，FAA 和 EASA 要求提供基于计算机的培训模块以及有针对性的模拟器课程，以使飞行员熟悉 EICAS 布局、重新定位的起落架手柄和更改的系统开关。尽管有巨大的 15.1 英寸玻璃屏幕，但基本的驾驶舱流程、飞行前检查表和头顶面板开关位置仍然与 NG 相同，因此数千个飞行小时建立的肌肉记忆可以直接转移到 MAX。

title_en: Why The Embraer E175's Thrust Sounds Loud For A Regional Jet
title_zh: 为什么巴西航空工业公司 E175 的推力对于支线喷气机来说听起来很大
summary: The E175's engines have a small bypass ratio by today's standards
summary_zh: 按照当今的标准，E175 发动机的涵道比较小
body_en: Why The Embraer E175's Thrust Sounds Loud For A Regional Jet

Based in the UK, Josh is a keen writer with a degree in Military History. Having worked previously as a financial journalist, he has covered the aviation industry extensively, reporting on airlines' results and monthly passenger statistics in the aftermath of the pandemic, alongside the likes of regulation around sustainable fuels, and the prospects for hydrogen-powered commercial flight. He joins Simple Flying with a lifelong love of all things aviation.

The Embraer E175 has come to be a vital cog in the machine that is the worldwide aviation network. Well positioned to serve regional travel markets and feed passengers into larger hub-and-spoke systems, the E175 has found success in all corners of the world over its 20 years of production.

But time has caught up to the E175 in one sense. Today, noise is a big consideration for regulators, airlines, airports, and manufacturers alike. While the E175 complies with current regulations on sound levels, newer models in its class are increasingly outperforming it on noise.

The E175 itself was among Embraer's answer to serving the short- to medium-haul space and bridging the gap between smaller regional jets and mainline narrowbodies. Developed as a stretched version of the E170 , the E175 is among four aircraft that make up the E-Jet family today. The E175 program launched in 1999, and the first model flew commercially with Air Canada in 2005.

Overall, the E-Jet family has enjoyed resounding success over its two-plus decades of service. According to Key.Aero , over 1,700 examples had rolled off the production line as of December last year, incorporating 196 E170s and 805 E175s, as well as 570 and 173 larger E190s and E195s , respectively.

The E175 has proven to be the most popular in the E-Jet series. Come December, 781 of the jets remained in active service, against 144 E170s, 399 E190s, and 129 E195s. The E175 remains in production, unlike its counterparts from the original E-Jet line, thanks to strong demand, particularly in the US , where it holds an approximate 80% share of the regional jet segment, according to the Ready For Take-Off Book . But despite the accolades that have kept the model in production over the years, the E175 is by no means a quiet plane by modern standards.

It is important to note that, by modern standards, the E175 can be considered loud. Against its closest competitor historically, the Bombardier CRJ900 , the E175 is relatively close in terms of noise. According to European Union Aviation Safety Agency type certification documents, an E175 weighing 85,517 pounds (38,790 kg) at takeoff was measured as producing 84.4 decibels of effective perceived noise during a flyover in 2025, for example. A CRJ900 of similar weight was recorded as producing 83.9 decibels, based on documents from two years earlier.

But an aircraft's loudness can vary by perspective and flight phase. The former matters because cabin noise affects passenger comfort and can even impact the health of those onboard. For instance, research from finance and travel site US Credit Card Guide shows the giant, four-engined Airbus A380 as being significantly quieter from a passenger’s point of view than the E175. From outside either aircraft, the A380 would naturally be louder, as the heavier model requires more thrust to get airborne.

Interestingly, widebody aircraft tend to be quieter from within the cabin than narrowbodies, despite being heavier and requiring more thrust from more powerful engines. This is often simply because passengers sit farther from the engines, and models like the A380 also incorporate technologies to absorb noise in cabins and engines. The E175’s cabin is louder than several widebodies, which helps explain why. What it does not explain, though, is why models from within the same regional class but produced more recently are also quieter.

It is when such newer, comparable models are factored in that the disparity becomes clear. Namely, the Airbus A220 is another that bridges the gap between regional and mainline narrowbody models, albeit towards the larger end of the spectrum than the E175. Nonetheless, the A220 offers a useful basis of comparison thanks to its relatively recent, clean-sheet design.

Developed as the Bombardier CSeries before Airbus bought a majority stake in the program in 2018, the A220 entered commercial service in 2016, two years earlier. That means the A220 incorporates more modern technology in comparison to the E175, including newer-generation geared turbofan Pratt & Whitney PW1500G engines. Among other things, the PW1500G has a gearbox between its fan and low-pressure core, allowing each to spin at an optimal speed — with the fan turning slower and helping reduce the aircraft’s noise footprint.

Overall, the A220 is considered one of the quietest commercial aircraft in service today. According to Airbus , the aircraft type's noise footprint is as much as 50% smaller than previous-generation aircraft. Against International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards introduced in 2006, which the E175 is said to “ meet or surpass, ” the A220’s difference is 18 effective perceived noise decibels. That is enough of a difference to hear, particularly against aging counterparts, according to aviation consultancy AirInsight . But it is not just the gear system that aids the PW1500G in being quieter. Bypass ratio is a major factor.

Embraer’s E175 is powered by two CF34-8E engines from GE Aerospace . Like the E175 itself, development of the CF34-8E began in the late nineties. As such, the engine is in many ways a product of its time. That includes its bypass ratio.

Equated to the ratio between the mass flow rate of air bypassing and the mass flow rate entering the engine core, bypass ratio plays a major role in both efficiency and noise. Air that enters the core is compressed before being mixed with fuel and combusted. The resulting hot gases then drive turbines, which are connected to the fan via a shaft. The fan, in turn, produces most of the thrust. That means a higher-bypass engine accelerates more air around its core than through it. Consequently, less reliance is placed on high-velocity exhaust gases from the core — a significant source of jet engine noise — to produce thrust.
*Automatic power reserve for added thrust in case of engine failure

By today’s standards , the CF34-8E’s 5:1 bypass ratio is low. The A220’s PW1500G, with a 73-inch (185.4 cm) fan diameter, far exceeds that, with a bypass ratio of 12:1. In practice, the CF34-8E relies on proportionally more air passing through its core to produce up to 14,500 pounds-force (64.5 kN) during takeoff. The A220 isn't the only aircraft to adopt higher-bypass engines; the technology is becoming increasingly common across the commercial industry, including on Embraer’s newer models.
body_zh: 为什么巴西航空工业公司 E175 的推力对于支线喷气机来说听起来很大
乔什居住在英国，是一位热心作家，拥有军事史学位。此前，他曾担任财经记者，广泛报道了航空业，报道了疫情后航空公司的业绩和每月乘客统计数据，以及可持续燃料的监管以及氢动力商业航班的前景等。他带着对航空一切事物的终生热爱加入了 Simple Flying。
巴西航空工业公司 E175 已成为全球航空网络机器中的重要齿轮。 E175 定位于服务区域旅行市场，并将乘客送入更大的轮辐式系统，在 20 年的生产过程中已在世界各个角落取得了成功。
但从某种意义上说，时间已经赶上了 E175。如今，噪音已成为监管机构、航空公司、机场和制造商等的重要考虑因素。虽然 E175 符合现行的声级规定，但同类产品中较新的型号在噪音方面的表现越来越好。
E175 本身就是巴西航空工业公司为中短程航空提供服务并缩小小型支线喷气式飞机与干线窄体飞机之间差距的解决方案之一。 E175 是 E170 的加长版，是当今 E-Jet 系列的四架飞机之一。 E175 项目于 1999 年启动，第一架型号于 2005 年与加拿大航空一起投入商业飞行。
总体而言，E-Jet 系列在其二十多年的服役生涯中取得了巨大的成功。据 Key.Aero 称，截至去年 12 月，已有超过 1,700 辆样车下线，其中包括 196 辆 E170 和 805 辆 E175，以及分别有 570 辆和 173 辆较大的 E190 和 E195。

E175 已被证明是 E-Jet 系列中最受欢迎的机型。截至 12 月，仍有 781 架喷气式飞机仍在服役，而 E170 为 144 架，E190 为 399 架，E195 为 129 架。根据《Ready For Take-Off Book》的数据，由于需求强劲，特别是在美国，与最初 E-Jet 系列的同类产品不同，E175 仍在生产，在美国，E175 占据支线喷气机市场约 80% 的份额。尽管多年来该机型一直在生产中屡获殊荣，但按照现代标准，E175 绝不是一架安静的飞机。
需要注意的是，按照现代标准，E175 的声音可能很大。与历史上最接近的竞争对手庞巴迪 CRJ900 相比，E175 在噪音方面相对接近。例如，根据欧盟航空安全局型号认证文件，一架起飞时重 85,517 磅（38,790 公斤）的 E175 在 2025 年飞越时测量到产生 84.4 分贝的有效感知噪音。根据两年前的文件，重量相似的 CRJ900 被记录为产生 83.9 分贝。
但飞机的响度可能会因视角和飞行阶段而异。前者很重要，因为机舱噪音会影响乘客的舒适度，甚至会影响机上人员的健康。例如，金融和旅游网站《美国信用卡指南》的研究表明，从乘客的角度来看，巨型四引擎空客 A380 比 E175 安静得多。从任何一架飞机的外部来看，A380 的声音自然会更大，因为较重的型号需要更大的推力才能升空。
有趣的是，宽体飞机在机舱内往往比窄体飞机更安静，尽管宽体飞机更重并且需要更强大的发动机提供更大的推力。这通常只是因为乘客坐得离发动机较远，而像 A380 这样的机型还采用了吸收客舱和发动机噪音的技术。 E175 的机舱声音比几款宽体飞机还要大，这有助于解释原因。但它没有解释为什么同一地区级别但生产较晚的车型也更安静。
当考虑到这些更新的、可比较的模型时，差异就变得明显了。也就是说，空客 A220 是另一款弥合支线窄体机和干线窄体机之间差距的机型，尽管其范围比 E175 更大。尽管如此，A220 凭借其相对较新的干净设计，提供了有用的比较基础。
A220 是在空客于 2018 年购买该项目多数股权之前开发的庞巴迪 CSeries，于 2016 年（即两年前）投入商业服务。这意味着与 E175 相比，A220 采用了更现代的技术，包括新一代齿轮传动涡轮风扇普惠 PW1500G 发动机。除此之外，PW1500G 在其风扇和低压核心之间有一个变速箱，使每个核心都能以最佳速度旋转 - 风扇转得更慢，有助于减少飞机的噪音足迹。

总体而言，A220 被认为是当今服役的最安静的商用飞机之一。据空中客车公司称，该机型的噪音足迹比上一代飞机小 50%。根据 2006 年推出的国际民用航空组织 (ICAO) 标准，据称 E175“达到或超过”了该标准，而 A220 的有效感知噪声分贝数相差 18 个分贝。根据航空咨询公司 AirInsight 的说法，这一差异足以听出，尤其是与老龄化同行相比。但帮助 PW1500G 变得更安静的不仅仅是齿轮系统。旁路比是一个主要因素。
巴西航空工业公司的 E175 由两台 GE 航空航天公司的 CF34-8E 发动机提供动力。与 E175 本身一样，CF34-8E 的开发始于九十年代末。因此，该发动机在很多方面都是当时的产物。这包括其涵道比。
涵道比等于旁路空气的质量流量与进入发动机核心的质量流量之间的比率，在效率和噪声方面都起着重要作用。进入核心的空气在与燃料混合并燃烧之前被压缩。产生的热气体然后驱动涡轮机，涡轮机通过轴连接到风扇。风扇又产生大部分推力。这意味着更高涵道比的发动机在其核心周围加速的空气多于通过核心的空气。因此，人们不太依赖来自核心的高速废气（喷气发动机噪音的重要来源）来产生推力。
*自动动力储备，在发动机故障时增加推力
按照今天的标准，CF34-8E 的 5:1 涵道比很低。 A220的PW1500G风扇直径为73英寸（185.4厘米），远超于此，涵道比为12:1。实际上，CF34-8E 在起飞过程中依靠通过其核心的更多空气来产生高达 14,500 磅的力（64.5 kN）。 A220 并不是唯一采用高涵道比发动机的飞机；该技术在商业行业中变得越来越普遍，包括巴西航空工业公司的新型号。

title_zh: 捷星航空首架航班抵达跑道，西悉尼机场正式启用
summary: Western Sydney International (Nancy-Bird Walton) Airport (WSI) today welcomed its first customers marking a seismic day for Australian… The post Western Sydney Airport opens as first Jetstar flight hits the runway appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 西悉尼国际（南希-伯德沃尔顿）机场 (WSI) 今天迎来了第一批乘客，标志着澳大利亚的地震日......
body_en: Western Sydney International (Nancy-Bird Walton) Airport (WSI) today welcomed its first customers marking a seismic day for Australian commercial aviation and the country’s largest city.

Starting proceedings on October 25, 2026, a Jetstar Airbus A320neo, registered VH-A5E, was first to hit the runway, departing Western Sydney International just after 11:20, local time, for a flight to Gold Coast Airport (OOL). A later Jetstar flight also departed for Melbourne Airport (MEL).
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese led the celebrations describing the opening as a “milestone that has been decades in the making”.

“For the first time in more than 50 years, Australia is opening a major new airport,” Prime Minister Albanese said. “I’ve been a strong supporter of this project for a long time and I’m very proud to officially open it. I want to thank the thousands of workers who made it happen.”
He added: “This airport will make a real difference for Western Sydney, creating jobs, supporting local businesses, and making it easier for people to travel for generations to come.”

A spokesperson for the airport said WSI will “transform the way Sydney-siders travel domestically and abroad, substantially boosting capacity, creating greater choice, and delivering 24-hour connectivity”.
Western Sydney, which will operate 24 hours a day, opens with the capacity to cater for up to 10 million passengers a year and has been designed to grow with Sydney.
Over time, it is expected to become Australia’s primary gateway, with capacity for more than 80 million passengers annually.
The airport’s airline partners include Jetstar, Air New Zealand, Singapore Airlines, Qantas Group, Vietjet, Fiji Airway and Qatar Airways.

“For decades, countless people have advocated for an airport in Western Sydney and the social and economic benefits it would provide,” Western Sydney Airport CEO Simon Hickey, said. “Today, that ambition will become a reality as we mark the beginning of an exciting new chapter in our city’s cultural heartland.”

He added: “WSI is the most transformational piece of infrastructure our nation has seen since the Syndey Harbour Bridge. It brings the world closer to Western Sydney and opportunity closer to home, creating new meaningful jobs for generations to come.”
Western Sydney International Airport is located at Badgerys Creek in Western Sydney, about 44 kilometers west of the city’s central business district.

body_zh: 西悉尼国际（南希-伯德沃尔顿）机场 (WSI) 今天迎来了第一批乘客，这对澳大利亚商业航空和该国最大的城市来说是一个重大的日子。
程序于 2026 年 10 月 25 日开始，一架注册为 VH-A5E 的捷星空客 A320neo 最先冲上跑道，于当地时间 11 点 20 分刚过西悉尼国际机场，飞往黄金海岸机场 (OOL)。随后的捷星航空航班也飞往墨尔本机场 (MEL)。
澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 主持了庆祝活动，将开业描述为“几十年来酝酿的里程碑”。
“澳大利亚 50 多年来首次开设一座大型新机场，”阿尔巴内塞总理表示。 “长期以来，我一直是这个项目的坚定支持者，我很自豪能够正式开放它。我要感谢成千上万的工作人员，是他们促成了这个项目。”
他补充道：“这个机场将为西悉尼带来真正的改变，创造就业机会，支持当地企业，并使子孙后代的出行更加便捷。”
机场发言人表示，WSI 将“改变悉尼人国内外旅行的方式，大幅提高运力，创造更多选择，并提供 24 小时连通性”。
西悉尼将全天 24 小时运营，每年可容纳多达 1000 万名旅客，并旨在与悉尼一起发展。
随着时间的推移，它预计将成为澳大利亚的主要门户，每年接待旅客超过 8000 万人次。
该机场的航空公司合作伙伴包括捷星航空、新西兰航空、新加坡航空、澳洲航空、越捷航空、斐济航空和卡塔尔航空。
西悉尼机场首席执行官西蒙·希基 (Simon Hickey) 表示：“几十年来，无数人一直主张在西悉尼建立机场及其所带来的社会和经济效益。” “今天，随着我们标志着我们城市文化中心激动人心的新篇章的开始，这一雄心壮志将成为现实。”
他补充道：“WSI 是自悉尼海港大桥以来我们国家最具变革性的基础设施。它拉近了世界与西悉尼的距离，让机遇离家乡更近，为子孙后代创造了新的有意义的就业机会。”
西悉尼国际机场位于西悉尼的 Badgerys Creek，距离城市中央商务区以西约 44 公里。

title_en: FAA orders checks on nearly 2,000 Boeing 737s after pitch oscillation events
title_zh: 俯仰振荡事件发生后，FAA 下令对近 2,000 架波音 737 进行检查
summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered inspections of nearly 2,000 Boeing 737 Next Generation aircraft after… The post FAA orders checks on nearly 2,000 Boeing 737s after pitch oscillation events appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 已下令对近 2,000 架下一代波音 737 飞机进行检查……
body_en: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has ordered inspections of nearly 2,000 Boeing 737 Next Generation aircraft after multiple operators reported pitch oscillations linked to excessive looseness in the horizontal stabilizer mechanism.

The airworthiness directive, published on October 19, 2026, requires operators to measure movement in the stabilizer’s pivot hinges and jackscrew, then carry out additional checks, repairs or parts replacements depending on the findings.
The FAA estimates that 1,987 US-registered aircraft are affected. The directive covers 737-600, -700, -700C, -800, -900 and -900ER aircraft. It does not apply to the 737 MAX.
The rule takes effect on November 23, 2026, with inspections due according to the compliance schedule incorporated into the directive.

The horizontal stabilizer is the movable horizontal surface on the aircraft’s tail that helps control its nose-up or nose-down attitude. Excessive movement within its supporting mechanism, known as freeplay, can allow unwanted motion.

The FAA said the reported pitch oscillations were caused by excessive stabilizer freeplay and warned that leaving the condition uncorrected could lead to flutter, a potentially dangerous vibration that can result in loss of control.
The final directive follows a proposed rule published in January 2026 and incorporates inspection procedures detailed in a Boeing bulletin from June 12, 2025.

Some airlines sought adjustments to the inspection requirements during the public comment period. Canadian North asked the FAA to extend the initial inspection threshold from 12 months to 36 months, arguing that the longer period would allow the work to coincide with heavy maintenance visits and give operators more time to arrange parts and labor.
United Airlines requested longer repeat inspection intervals for aircraft fitted with replacement hinge bearings, compared with those retaining their original parts.

The FAA rejected both requests. It said the inspection schedule was necessary to maintain an acceptable level of safety and that excessive freeplay needed to be monitored whether components were original, repaired or newly installed.
The agency said it would consider individual requests for extensions if operators supplied sufficient evidence that an alternative schedule would maintain safety.

The agency estimates that the freeplay measurement will require six work-hours per aircraft, costing $510 at its assumed labor rate of $85 an hour. Across the affected US fleet, that amounts to approximately $1 million.

Additional inspections and repairs would increase those costs. The FAA said it could not determine how many aircraft would need replacement components and did not have definitive prices for the worn parts that might require replacement.
The post FAA orders checks on nearly 2,000 Boeing 737s after pitch oscillation events appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 在多家运营商报告水平安定面机构过度松动导致俯仰振荡后，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 已下令对近 2,000 架下一代波音 737 飞机进行检查。
2026 年 10 月 19 日发布的适航指令要求运营商测量稳定器枢轴铰链和螺旋千斤顶的运动，然后根据结果进行额外的检查、维修或零件更换。
FAA 估计有 1,987 架在美国注册的飞机受到影响。该指令涵盖 737-600、-700、-700C、-800、-900 和 -900ER 飞机。它不适用于 737 MAX。
该规则于 2026 年 11 月 23 日生效，并根据指令中纳入的合规时间表进行检查。
水平稳定器是飞机尾部的可移动水平表面，有助于控制机头向上或机头向下的姿态。其支撑机构内的过度运动（称为自由运动）可能会导致不必要的运动。
美国联邦航空局表示，报告的俯仰振荡是由稳定器过度自由运动引起的，并警告说，如果不纠正这种情况可能会导致颤振，这是一种潜在的危险振动，可能导致失控。
最终指令遵循 2026 年 1 月发布的拟议规则，并纳入了 2025 年 6 月 12 日波音公告中详细介绍的检查程序。
一些航空公司在公众意见征询期间寻求调整检查要求。加拿大北方公司要求美国联邦航空局将初始检查期限从 12 个月延长至 36 个月，理由是更长的期限可以让工作与繁重的维护访问同时进行，并让运营商有更多的时间来安排零件和劳动力。
与保留原始部件的飞机相比，美国联合航空公司要求对装有替换铰链轴承的飞机进行更长的重复检查间隔。
美国联邦航空局拒绝了这两项请求。它表示，检查计划对于保持可接受的安全水平是必要的，并且需要监控过度的自由发挥，无论组件是原装的、修理过的还是新安装的。
该机构表示，如果运营商提供足够的证据证明替代时间表可以保证安全，它将考虑个人的延期请求。
该机构估计，自由活动测量将需要每架飞机 6 个小时的工作时间，按照每小时 85 美元的假设劳动费率计算，成本为 510 美元。受影响的美国机队损失金额约为 100 万美元。
额外的检查和维修会增加这些成本。美国联邦航空局表示，无法确定有多少架飞机需要更换部件，也没有可能需要更换的磨损部件的明确价格。
在 AeroTime 首次出现俯仰振荡事件后，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 下令对近 2,000 架波音 737 进行检查。

title_en: IATA Summer & Winter Airline Schedules: What Are They, Why Should You Care?
title_zh: IATA 夏季和冬季航班时刻表：它们是什么，您为什么要关心？
summary: IATA splits the year into summer and winter airline schedules, with changes on the last weekend of March and October. Here's what that means for slots, routes, and aircraft.
summary_zh: 国际航空运输协会 (IATA) 将一年中的航班时刻表分为夏季和冬季，并在 3 月和 10 月的最后一个周末进行更改。这对于老虎机意味着什么
body_en: For airlines, there are two key dates every year that have a big impact on network planning, and they coincide with the start of the IATA summer and winter schedules. In this post I’d like to explain what those dates are, and why they matter.

Today happens to be the first day of the IATA winter schedule, so you’ll notice flight schedules at some airports look different today compared to yesterday. Understandably, this is something that the average air traveler probably doesn’t think about much.

The International Air Transport Association (IATA) is an important body for the airline industry, and it has what’s referred to as summer and winter schedules for airlines. This has implications for airlines, airports, and by connection, consumers. The schedules “flip” at the same time every year
The summer season runs from the last Sunday in March until the last Saturday in October
The winter season runs from the last Sunday in October until the last Saturday in March

As you can see, the summer schedule lasts around seven months, while the winter schedule lasts around five months. The timing coincides with when Daylight Savings Time (DST) starts and ends in Europe. Yes, yesterday was the last day of the IATA summer season, and today is the first day of the IATA winter season.
What are the practical implications for airlines?

What’s the importance of IATA seasons changing between summer and winter? When an airline operates a summer seasonal route, it’s not like it always exactly coincides with the IATA summer season. Quite to the contrary, airlines are all over the place with how long they operate seasonal routes, since demand varies by market.

So, why do the IATA seasons matter? Most concretely, for the airports that are slot controlled, slot allocations happen seasonally. So if an airline gains or loses slots (this can happen for a variety of reasons), those slots have to be used with a schedule that coincides with the IATA summer or winter season. Also keep in mind that slots have a “use it or lose it” clause, so airlines have to use those slots if they want to keep them.

Airline route planning is incredibly complex, so as part of this, airlines often also massively adjust their schedule around the start and end of the IATA seasons. It’s not like there’s anything magical about the last weekend in March and the last weekend in October, but airline network planning is like a jigsaw puzzle, and there are so many moving parts. So it’s often convenient to make scheduled adjustments around that time.

So my point is to say that you’ll typically notice the biggest airline changes coinciding with these seasons. That could include frequencies or routes being added or eliminated, aircraft types or certain configurations being reassigned, etc.

For example, living in Miami, it’s always fascinating to be on Flightradar24 the day before and after the IATA season changes. Since Miami is one of the few US destinations with stronger demand in winter, with the start of the IATA winter season our skies get busier, and we see more routes and bigger planes.

Just to give some examples of changes in Miami (MIA), today marks the first day of winter seasonal service from Barcelona (BCN) on LEVEL, from Copenhagen (CPH) on Scandinavian Airlines, from Dublin (DUB) on Aer Lingus, from Keflavik (KEF) on Icelandair, and from Munich (MUC) on Lufthansa. I’m sure there are a lot more changes, but those are just some examples.
Again, the change of the IATA seasons isn’t the only time that routes are updated, but it’s the most common time for these changes.

IATA splits the year into two seasons — summer and winter — with the changes kicking in as of the last weekend in March and last weekend in October. This has major implications for airlines, including that we frequently see route adjustments and equipment swaps coinciding with those dates.

I know this is very obvious to some, but for those who aren’t aware of this, I figure it’s worth covering. It’s not a coincidence that two weekends every year see the most changes to airline schedules.
body_zh: 对于航空公司来说，每年有两个对网络规划影响较大的关键日期，这两个日期与 IATA 夏季和冬季航班时刻表的开始时间重合。在这篇文章中，我想解释这些日期是什么，以及它们为何重要。
今天恰好是国际航空运输协会冬季时刻表的第一天，因此您会注意到一些机场的航班时刻表今天与昨天相比有所不同。可以理解的是，普通航空旅行者可能不会考虑太多这一点。
国际航空运输协会 (IATA) 是航空业的重要机构，它为航空公司制定了所谓的夏季和冬季时刻表。这对航空公司、机场以及消费者都有影响。时间表每年都会在同一时间“翻转”：
夏季从三月的最后一个星期日到十月的最后一个星期六
冬季从十月的最后一个星期日到三月的最后一个星期六
如您所见，夏季赛程持续约七个月，而冬季赛程持续约五个月。该时间与欧洲夏令时 (DST) 的开始和结束时间一致。是的，昨天是 IATA 夏季的最后一天，今天是 IATA 冬季的第一天。
对航空公司有什么实际影响？
IATA 夏季和冬季季节变化的重要性是什么？当航空公司运营夏季季节性航线时，它并不总是与 IATA 夏季恰好吻合。恰恰相反，航空公司对于运营季节性航线的时间长短有着不同的看法，因为需求因市场而异。
那么，为什么 IATA 季节很重要？最具体地说，对于起降时刻控制的机场来说，起降时刻分配是季节性的。因此，如果航空公司获得或失去航班时刻（发生这种情况的原因有多种），这些航班时刻的使用时间必须与 IATA 夏季或冬季相符。另请记住，航班时刻有“使用它或失去它”的条款，因此航空公司如果想保留这些航班时刻，就必须使用这些航班时刻。
航空公司的航线规划极其复杂，因此航空公司通常也会在 IATA 季节开始和结束时大规模调整其航班时刻表。 3月的最后一个周末和10月的最后一个周末并不是什么神奇的事情，但航空公司网络规划就像拼图游戏，有很多移动的部件。因此，在那个时间附近进行预定的调整通常很方便。
所以我的意思是说，您通常会注意到航空公司最大的变化与这些季节同时发生。这可能包括添加或取消频率或航线、重新分配飞机类型或某些配置等。
例如，生活在迈阿密，在 IATA 季节变化的前后一天关注 Flightradar24 总是令人着迷。由于迈阿密是美国少数几个冬季需求强劲的目的地之一，随着国际航空运输协会冬季的开始，我们的天空变得更加繁忙，我们看到更多的航线和更大的飞机。
仅举迈阿密 (MIA) 变化的一些例子，今天是 LEVEL 从巴塞罗那 (BCN) 出发、斯堪的纳维亚航空从哥本哈根 (CPH) 出发、爱尔兰航空从都柏林 (DUB) 出发、冰岛航空从凯夫拉维克 (KEF) 出发以及汉莎航空从慕尼黑 (MUC) 出发的冬季季节性航班的第一天。我确信还有更多的变化，但这只是一些例子。
同样，IATA 季节的变化并不是航线更新的唯一时间，但却是这些变化最常见的时间。
国际航空运输协会将一年分为两个季节——夏季和冬季——变化从三月的最后一个周末和十月的最后一个周末开始生效。这对航空公司具有重大影响，包括我们经常看到与这些日期同时发生的航线调整和设备更换。
我知道这对某些人来说是非常明显的，但对于那些没有意识到这一点的人来说，我认为值得一提。每年的两个周末航空公司时刻表变化最多，这并非巧合。

title_zh: 奥斯汀风暴迫使西欧各地的航班取消和改道
summary: Storm Austen disrupted air travel across Western Europe on Friday, 23 October, forcing cancellations in the Channel Islands, France and the Netherlands, while flights bound for Paris and Brussels were diverted to alternative airports. The disruption varied con
summary_zh: 10 月 23 日星期五，奥斯汀风暴扰乱了西欧各地的航空旅行，导致海峡群岛、法国和荷兰的航班取消
body_en: Storm Austen forces flight cancellations and diversions across Western Europe - Aviation24.be

Storm Austen disrupted air travel across Western Europe on Friday, 23 October, forcing cancellations in the Channel Islands, France and the Netherlands, while flights bound for Paris and Brussels were diverted to alternative airports.

The disruption varied considerably between airports. Channel Island services were particularly badly affected, while larger hubs continued operating with adjustments. No consolidated Europe-wide cancellation total was available in the reports reviewed.

Jersey recorded 41 cancelled flight movements on Friday—22 departures and 19 arrivals—according to an assessment of the airport’s published flight boards by aviation publication Aerosillage. Guernsey also experienced extensive disruption, with operations resuming on Saturday. Jersey authorities had issued a red wind warning ahead of the storm, forecasting gusts of approximately 61–70 knots.

In western France, the same assessment recorded 11 cancelled movements at Brest and three at Caen, while Transavia departures from Nantes were also affected. These airport-level figures represent individual arrivals and departures, rather than return journeys, and are not a comprehensive regional total.

Paris Charles de Gaulle experienced diversions as the weather crossed northern France. French Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot reported aircraft being redirected to Paris Orly, with further diversions to other airports anticipated. Reuters

Brussels Airport both received diverted flights and lost an incoming service to another airport. A Brussels Airlines flight from Marseille diverted to Amsterdam Schiphol, while several aircraft originally bound for French airports landed at Zaventem instead, according to airport spokeswoman Ihsane Chioua Lekhli, quoted in reporting sourced to HLN.

The available reporting does not establish a storm-related cancellation total for Brussels Airport or Brussels South Charleroi. Diversions should therefore be distinguished from cancellations, and the disruption should not be interpreted as a general closure of Belgian airports.
KLM cuts flights as unsettled weather continues

KLM cancelled 20 flights on Friday and announced a further 22 cancellations for Saturday because of strong winds in the Netherlands, an airline spokesperson told Reuters. Schiphol nevertheless reported limited overall disruption at the time, with no other airlines cancelling flights for the same weather conditions.

The difficult conditions were not confined to the airfield: disrupted rail services, fallen trees and road restrictions also complicated journeys to airports. A second storm, Boelo, was forecast to affect Northern Ireland, Scotland and parts of northern England over the weekend, creating a further risk of disruption as airlines worked to restore their schedules.
Sources: Reuters , aerosillage.com , Zaventem.me

10 月 23 日星期五，奥斯汀风暴扰乱了西欧各地的航空旅行，迫使海峡群岛、法国和荷兰的航班取消，而飞往巴黎和布鲁塞尔的航班则改道至其他机场。
不同机场之间的干扰情况差异很大。海峡群岛的服务受到的影响尤其严重，而较大的枢纽在调整后继续运营。审查的报告中没有提供欧洲范围内的综合取消总数。
根据航空出版物 Aerosillage 对机场公布的航班信息板的评估，泽西岛周五记录了 41 架取消的航班，其中 22 架出发，19 架到达。根西岛也经历了广泛的中断，周六恢复运营。泽西岛当局在风暴来临前发布了红风警告，预计阵风约为 61-70 节。
在法国西部，同一评估记录了布雷斯特 11 趟航班取消，卡昂 3 趟航班取消，而 Transavia 从南特出发的航班也受到影响。这些机场层面的数据代表的是单独的抵达和出发航班，而不是回程航班，也不是全面的地区总数。
随着天气穿越法国北部，巴黎戴高乐机场经历了改道。法国交通部长菲利普·塔巴罗特报告称，飞机已改道飞往巴黎奥利机场，预计将进一步改道至其他机场。路透社
布鲁塞尔机场收到了改道的航班，并失去了飞往另一个机场的入境服务。 HLN 援引机场发言人 Ihsane Chioua Lekhli 的话说，布鲁塞尔航空公司的一架从马赛出发的航班改道飞往阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场，而几架原本飞往法国机场的飞机则降落在扎芬特姆。
现有报告并未确定布鲁塞尔机场或布鲁塞尔南沙勒罗瓦与风暴相关的航班取消总数。因此，应将改道与取消区分开来，并且这种干扰不应被解释为比利时机场的全面关闭。
由于天气持续不稳定，荷航削减航班
荷兰皇家航空发言人告诉路透社，由于荷兰强风，荷兰皇家航空公司周五取消了 20 趟航班，并宣布周六又取消 22 趟航班。尽管如此，史基浦机场当时报告称总体中断有限，没有其他航空公司因相同的天气条件取消航班。
困难的情况不仅限于机场：铁路服务中断、树木倒下和道路限制也使前往机场的旅程变得复杂。据预测，第二场风暴“博埃洛”将在周末影响北爱尔兰、苏格兰和英格兰北部部分地区，在航空公司努力恢复航班时刻之际，这将带来进一步的中断风险。
